211	    const promise = this.load({ runId, beforeToken: oldestToken, limit }).then(
212	      (response) => {
213	        const current = this.getState(runId);
214	        const next: ConversationTranscriptState = {
215	          ...current,
216	          entries: coalesceWorkerEntriesById([...response.entries, ...current.entries]) as ConversationTranscriptEntry[],
217	          latestToken: current.latestToken ?? response.latestToken,
218	          oldestToken: response.oldestToken ?? current.oldestToken,
219	          hasOlder: Boolean(response.hasOlder),
220	          workerIds: response.workerIds,
221	          status: "loaded",
222	          lastError: null,
223	          hasLoadedOnce: true,
224	        };
225	        this.updateState(runId, next);
226	      },
227	      (error: unknown) => {
228	        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
229	        const failing = this.getState(runId);
230	        this.updateState(runId, { ...failing, status: "error", lastError: message });
231	      },
232	    ).finally(() => {
233	      this.inFlightByRunId.delete(runId);
234	    });
235	    this.inFlightByRunId.set(runId, promise);
236	    return promise;
237	  }
238	}
239	
240	export const conversationTranscriptManager = new ConversationTranscriptManager();
241	
242	interface UseConversationTranscriptOptions {
243	  refreshIntervalMs?: number | null;
244	  enabled?: boolean;
245	}
246	
247	/**
248	 * Subscribe to the merged conversation transcript for a run. When
249	 * `runId` is null or `options.enabled` is false, returns an empty
250	 * state and skips the fetch.
251	 */
252	export function useConversationTranscript(
253	  runId: string | null,
254	  options: UseConversationTranscriptOptions = {},
255	) {
256	  const runtimeApis = useRuntimeAPIs();
257	  conversationTranscriptManager.configure(runtimeApis.conversations.transcript);
258	  const enabled = options.enabled !== false && Boolean(runId);
259	
260	  const state = useSyncExternalStore(
261	    useCallback((listener) => (
262	      runId && enabled ? conversationTranscriptManager.subscribe(runId, listener) : () => {}
263	    ), [runId, enabled]),
264	    useCallback(() => (
265	      runId && enabled ? conversationTranscriptManager.getState(runId) : EMPTY
266	    ), [runId, enabled]),
267	    () => EMPTY,
268	  );
269	
270	  useEffect(() => {
271	    if (!runId || !enabled) return;
272	    void conversationTranscriptManager.ensureLoaded(runId);
273	  }, [runId, enabled]);
274	
275	  useEffect(() => {
276	    if (!runId || !enabled) return;
277	    if (!options.refreshIntervalMs || options.refreshIntervalMs <= 0) return;
278	    const handle = window.setInterval(() => {
279	      void conversationTranscriptManager.refresh(runId);
280	    }, options.refreshIntervalMs);
281	    return () => window.clearInterval(handle);
282	  }, [enabled, options.refreshIntervalMs, runId]);
283	
284	  const entries = useMemo(() => state.entries, [state.entries]);
285	
286	  const loadOlder = useCallback((limit?: number) => {
287	    if (!runId) return Promise.resolve();
288	    return conversationTranscriptManager.loadOlder(runId, limit);
289	  }, [runId]);
290	
291	  return {
292	    state,
293	    entries,
294	    isLoaded: state.status === "loaded",
295	    hasLoadedOnce: state.hasLoadedOnce,
296	    hasOlder: state.hasOlder,
297	    loadOlder,
298	    workerIds: state.workerIds,
299	  };
300	}
301

24	
25	type LegacyJsonRequester = <T>(
26	  input: RequestInfo | URL,
27	  init?: RequestInit,
28	  fallback?: Partial<AppErrorDescriptor>,
29	) => Promise<T>;
30	
31	type LegacyEventSource = {
32	  close(): void;
33	  onerror: ((event: Event) => void) | null;
34	  onopen: ((event: Event) => void) | null;
35	  addEventListener(type: string, listener: (event: MessageEvent) => void): void;
36	};
37	
38	type LegacyEventSourceConstructor = new (url: string) => LegacyEventSource;
39	
40	function runParameter(runId: string | null | undefined, prefix: "?" | "&") {
41	  const value = runId?.trim();
42	  return value ? `${prefix}runId=${encodeURIComponent(value)}` : "";
43	}
44	
45	export function buildEventStreamUrl(
46	  selectedRunId?: string | null,
47	  lastEventId?: string | number | null,
48	) {
49	  const runParam = runParameter(selectedRunId, "?");
50	  const cursor = String(lastEventId ?? "").trim();
51	  return `/api/events${runParam}${cursor
52	    ? `${runParam ? "&" : "?"}cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`
53	    : ""}`;
54	}
55	
56	export function buildPersistedSnapshotUrl(
57	  selectedRunId?: string | null,
58	  checksum?: string | null,
59	) {
60	  const checksumParam = checksum?.trim()
61	    ? `&checksum=${encodeURIComponent(checksum.trim())}`
62	    : "";
63	  return `/api/events?snapshot=1&persisted=1${runParameter(selectedRunId, "&")}${checksumParam}`;
64	}
65	
66	export function createLegacyLiveEventAPIs(options: {
67	  EventSourceConstructor?: LegacyEventSourceConstructor;
68	  requestJson?: LegacyJsonRequester;
69	  requestSnapshot?: LegacySnapshotRequester;
70	  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
71	}): Pick<RuntimeAPIs["events"], "snapshot" | "open"> {
72	  const EventSourceConstructor = options.EventSourceConstructor
73	    ?? EventSource as unknown as LegacyEventSourceConstructor;
74	  return {
75	    async snapshot(input): Promise<RuntimeSnapshotResult> {
76	      const url = buildPersistedSnapshotUrl(input.runId, input.checksum);
77	      const fallback = {
78	        source: "Events",
79	        action: "Load live state snapshot",
80	      };
81	      if (options.requestSnapshot) {
82	        const result = await options.requestSnapshot(url, undefined, fallback);
83	        return {
84	          data: result.data,
85	          lastEventId: result.lastEventId ?? null,
86	        };
87	      }
88	      if (options.requestJson) {
89	        return {
90	          data: await options.requestJson(url, undefined, fallback),
91	          lastEventId: null,
92	        };
93	      }
94	      const fetchImpl = options.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
95	      const response = await fetchImpl(url, undefined);
96	      if (!response.ok) {
97	        throw new AppRequestError(await parseErrorResponse(response, fallback));
98	      }
99	      return {
100	        data: await response.json(),
101	        lastEventId: response.headers.get("x-omni-last-event-id"),
102	      };
103	    },
104	    open(input, handlers: EventStreamHandlers): RuntimeSubscription {
105	      const source = new EventSourceConstructor(
106	        buildEventStreamUrl(input.runId, input.lastEventId),
107	      );
108	      const eventTypes = [
109	        "update",
110	        "update_error",
111	        "worker.entry_appended",
112	        "stream.resync_required",
113	      ];
114	      for (const type of eventTypes) {
115	        source.addEventListener(type, (event) => {
116	          handlers.onEvent(normalizeRuntimeStreamEvent({
117	            type,
118	            data: event.data,
119	            lastEventId: event.lastEventId,
120	          }));
121	        });
122	      }
123	      source.onopen = () => handlers.onOpen?.();
124	      source.onerror = () => {
125	        handlers.onError?.({
126	          code: "runtime.events_failed",
127	          message: "Event stream failed.",
128	          surface: "web",
129	        });
130	      };
131	      return { close: () => source.close() };
132	    },
133	  };
134	}

684	// Internal: snapshot marker stored in the ring so `Last-Event-ID` resume
685	// from immediately after a snapshot remains resolvable. The marker itself
686	// is not emitted as a named SSE frame — it just reserves an id and lets
687	// the route render a fresh snapshot on replay.
688	export type SnapshotMarker = {
689	  kind: "snapshot.marker";
690	  version: number;
691	};
692	
693	export type BufferedEntry =
694	  | { id: number; streamId: EventStreamId; emittedAt: number; runId: string | null; event: NamedEvent }
695	  | { id: number; streamId: EventStreamId; emittedAt: number; runId: string | null; event: SnapshotMarker };
696	
697	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
698	// Ring buffer
699	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
700	
701	const RING_CAPACITY = 4096;
702	let cursor = 0;
703	let streamEpoch = randomBytes(18).toString("base64url");
704	let lastHeartbeatAt = 0;
705	const ring: BufferedEntry[] = [];
706	
707	function pickRunId(event: NamedEvent | SnapshotMarker): string | null {
708	  if ("runId" in event && typeof event.runId === "string") {
709	    return event.runId;
710	  }
711	  return null;
712	}
713	
714	function append(event: NamedEvent | SnapshotMarker, runIdOverride?: string | null): BufferedEntry {
715	  cursor += 1;
716	  const entry = {
717	    id: cursor,
718	    streamId: formatEventStreamId(streamEpoch, cursor),
719	    emittedAt: Date.now(),
720	    runId: runIdOverride ?? pickRunId(event),
721	    event,
722	  } as BufferedEntry;
723	  ring.push(entry);
724	  if (ring.length > RING_CAPACITY) {
725	    ring.shift();
726	  }
727	  return entry;
728	}
729	
730	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
731	// Public emit API
732	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
733	
734	/**
735	 * Emit a named lifecycle event. Records the event in the ring buffer
736	 * and signals the SSE stream to wake up so subscribed clients receive
737	 * the frame promptly.
738	 */
739	export function emitNamedEvent(event: NamedEvent): BufferedEntry {
740	  const entry = append(event);
741	  notifyEventStreamSubscribers();
742	  return entry;
743	}
744	
745	export function emitStreamHeartbeatIfDue(
746	  now = Date.now(),
747	  minimumIntervalMs = 10_000,
748	): BufferedEntry | null {
749	  if (lastHeartbeatAt > 0 && now - lastHeartbeatAt < minimumIntervalMs) {
750	    return null;
751	  }
752	  lastHeartbeatAt = now;
753	  return emitNamedEvent({
754	    kind: "stream.heartbeat",
755	    emittedAt: new Date(now).toISOString(),
756	  });
757	}
758	
759	/**
760	 * Reserve a ring-buffer id for an upcoming `update` snapshot frame.
761	 * The marker itself carries no data the client renders — its only
762	 * purpose is to keep the id sequence contiguous so `Last-Event-ID`
763	 * resume after a snapshot frame can be resolved from the ring buffer.
764	 *
765	 * Note: this does NOT notify subscribers; the caller is mid-stream and
766	 * will write the snapshot frame itself.
767	 */
768	export function recordSnapshotMarker(
769	  version: number,
770	  runId: string | null = null,
771	): BufferedEntry {
772	  return append({ kind: "snapshot.marker", version }, runId);
773	}
774	
775	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
776	// Resume / replay
777	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
778	
779	export type ReplayResult = {
780	  /** True iff the requested `lastEventId` has fallen out of the ring
781	   * buffer; the client should re-bootstrap via /api/events?snapshot=1. */
782	  resyncRequired: boolean;
783	  /** Stable reason supplied when replay is impossible. */
784	  resyncReason: StreamResyncReason | null;
785	  /** Events strictly newer than `lastEventId`, in id order, filtered to
786	   * the given runId scope when provided. Snapshot markers are excluded
787	   * from the returned list — the SSE route renders them as fresh
788	   * snapshots inline rather than replaying their stored form. */
789	  events: BufferedEntry[];
790	  /** Current cursor at the time of the call. Clients should resume
791	   * from this id on the next call after consuming the events. */
792	  lastEventId: number;
793	  /** Epoch-aware cursor exposed to SSE clients. */
794	  lastStreamId: EventStreamId;
795	};
796	
797	export type ReplayOptions = {
798	  /** Filter to events scoped to this runId or unscoped (runId=null in
799	   * the buffer). Pass null/undefined to receive all events. */
800	  runId?: string | null;
801	  /** Return only events at or below this id. Used by the SSE route to
802	   * catch events that arrive just before a snapshot marker without
803	   * delivering later events before the marker frame. */
804	  throughId?: number | null;
805	  /** Include snapshot markers in the returned events. The SSE route
806	   * uses this internally; the dev log endpoint does not. */
807	  includeSnapshotMarkers?: boolean;
808	};
809	
810	export function getEventCursor(): number {
811	  return cursor;
812	}
813	
814	export function getEventStreamCursor(): EventStreamId {
815	  return formatEventStreamId(streamEpoch, cursor);
816	}
817	
818	export function getEventStreamEpoch(): string {
819	  return streamEpoch;
820	}
821	
822	export function getNamedEventsSince(
823	  lastEventId: number | string | null,
824	  options: ReplayOptions = {},
825	): ReplayResult {
826	  const includeMarkers = options.includeSnapshotMarkers === true;
827	  const runIdFilter = options.runId ?? null;
828	  const throughId = typeof options.throughId === "number" && Number.isFinite(options.throughId)
829	    ? Math.floor(options.throughId)
830	    : null;
831	
832	  let lastSequence: number | null = null;
833	  if (typeof lastEventId === "number") {
834	    lastSequence = Number.isSafeInteger(lastEventId) && lastEventId >= 0
835	      ? lastEventId
836	      : null;
837	  } else if (typeof lastEventId === "string") {
838	    const parsed = parseEventStreamId(lastEventId);
839	    if (parsed) {
840	      if (parsed.epoch !== streamEpoch) {
841	        return {
842	          resyncRequired: true,
843	          resyncReason: "epoch_mismatch",
844	          events: [],
845	          lastEventId: cursor,
846	          lastStreamId: getEventStreamCursor(),
847	        };
848	      }
849	      lastSequence = parsed.sequence;
850	    } else if (/^\d+$/.test(lastEventId.trim())) {
851	      const legacySequence = Number(lastEventId);
852	      lastSequence = Number.isSafeInteger(legacySequence) ? legacySequence : null;
853	    }
854	  }
855	
856	  // A client carrying a `lastEventId` greater than our current cursor
857	  // means the server cursor was reset under their feet (process
858	  // restart, ring purge, or simply a client that lied). Either way, we
859	  // cannot replay backwards from a position we never reached — tell
860	  // them to resync from /api/events?snapshot=1.
861	  if (lastSequence !== null && lastSequence > cursor) {
862	    return {
863	      resyncRequired: true,
864	      resyncReason: "cursor_evicted",
865	      events: [],
866	      lastEventId: cursor,
867	      lastStreamId: getEventStreamCursor(),
868	    };
869	  }
870	
871	  if (ring.length === 0) {
872	    return {
873	      resyncRequired: false,
874	      resyncReason: null,
875	      events: [],
876	      lastEventId: cursor,
877	      lastStreamId: getEventStreamCursor(),
878	    };
879	  }
880	
881	  const oldest = ring[0]!.id;
882	  // A client passing `lastEventId` strictly less than (oldest - 1) has
883	  // missed at least one event we no longer hold. Tell them to resync.
884	  // The off-by-one (oldest - 1) is intentional: if the client's last id
885	  // equals (oldest - 1), the very next event in the buffer is the one
886	  // they need, which is fine.
887	  if (lastSequence !== null && lastSequence < oldest - 1) {
888	    return {
889	      resyncRequired: true,
890	      resyncReason: "cursor_evicted",
891	      events: [],
892	      lastEventId: cursor,
893	      lastStreamId: getEventStreamCursor(),
894	    };
895	  }
896	
897	  const events = ring.filter((entry) => {
898	    if (lastSequence !== null && entry.id <= lastSequence) {
899	      return false;
900	    }
901	    if (throughId !== null && entry.id > throughId) {
902	      return false;
903	    }
904	    if (!includeMarkers && entry.event.kind === "snapshot.marker") {
905	      return false;
906	    }
907	    if (runIdFilter !== null && entry.runId !== null && entry.runId !== runIdFilter) {
908	      return false;
909	    }
910	    return true;
911	  });
912	
913	  return {
914	    resyncRequired: false,
915	    resyncReason: null,
916	    events,
917	    lastEventId: cursor,
918	    lastStreamId: getEventStreamCursor(),
919	  };
920	}
921	
922	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
923	// Test hooks
924	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
925

928	  cursor = 0;
929	  lastHeartbeatAt = 0;
930	  ring.length = 0;
931	}

934	export function __setStreamEpochForTests(epoch: string) {
935	  formatEventStreamId(epoch, 0);
936	  streamEpoch = epoch;
937	}
938	
939	/** @internal — vitest only */
940	export function __getRingForTests(): readonly BufferedEntry[] {
941	  return ring;
942	}
943	
944	/** @internal — vitest only */
945	export function __getRingCapacity() {
946	  return RING_CAPACITY;
947	}

343	                        <GitCommitHorizontal className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("commit.menu.commitAndPushProject")}
344	                      </DropdownMenuItem>
345	                      <DropdownMenuItem className="cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap text-destructive focus:bg-destructive/10 focus:text-destructive" onClick={() => handleRemoveProject(group.path)}>
346	                        <Trash2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("conversation.sidebar.removeProject")}
347	                      </DropdownMenuItem>
348	                    </DropdownMenuContent>
349	                  </DropdownMenu>
350	                </div>
351	              ) : (
352	                <div className="h-6 w-[3.875rem] shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
353	              )}
354	            </div>
355	
356	            <div
357	              className={cn(
358	                COLLAPSIBLE_PANEL_TRANSITION_CLASS,
359	                projectOpen ? COLLAPSIBLE_PANEL_OPEN_CLASS : COLLAPSIBLE_PANEL_CLOSED_CLASS,
360	              )}
361	              aria-hidden={!projectOpen}
362	            >
363	              <div className="min-h-0 space-y-0.5 overflow-hidden">
364	                {group.runs.length === 0 ? (
365	                  isHydratingConversations ? (
366	                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-1 pl-8 text-xs text-muted-foreground/70">
367	                      <LoaderCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
368	                      <span>{t("conversation.sidebar.loadingConversations")}</span>
369	                    </div>
370	                  ) : (
371	                    <div className="py-1 pl-8 text-xs italic text-muted-foreground/60">No conversations</div>
372	                  )
373	                ) : null}
374	                {visibleRuns.map((run) => {
375	                  const visualKind = getConversationVisualKind(run);
376	                  const isCommitConversation = visualKind === "commit";
377	                  const canArchiveConversation = isArchivableRunStatus(run.status);
378	                  const canMoveConversation = isTerminalRunStatus(run.status);
379	                  const normalizedRunStatus = normalizeRunStatus(run.status);
380	                  const runIsUnread = isRunUnread({
381	                    latestMessageAt: getRunLatestUnreadTimestamp(run, messages || []),
382	                    lastReadAt: readMarkers[run.id] ?? null,
383	                  });
384	                  const showCompletedAttentionIndicator = normalizedRunStatus === "done" && runIsUnread;
385	                  const showAwaitingUserIndicator = normalizedRunStatus === "awaiting_user";
386	                  const statusIndicatorLabel = showAwaitingUserIndicator
387	                    ? t("conversation.sidebar.status.awaitingUser")
388	                    : showCompletedAttentionIndicator
389	                      ? t("conversation.sidebar.status.completedAttention")
390	                      : null;
391	                  const visualConfig = CONVERSATION_VISUAL_CONFIG[visualKind];
392	                  const ConversationIcon = visualConfig.Icon;
393	
394	                  return (
395	                    <div
396	                      key={run.id}
397	                      data-conversation-run-id={run.id}
398	                      onClick={() => selectRun(run.id)}
399	                      onDoubleClick={(event) => {
400	                        const target = event.target;
401	                        if (target instanceof Element && target.closest("button,input,textarea,select,a")) {
402	                          return;
403	                        }
404	                        event.preventDefault();
405	                        startRenamingRun(run);
406	                      }}
407	                      className={cn(
408	                        "group flex min-w-0 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden rounded-xl py-1.5 pl-2.5 pr-2 text-sm transition-colors",
409	                        selectedRunId === run.id
410	                          ? "bg-[#e2e1df] text-[#1f1f1f] dark:bg-white/[0.08] dark:text-zinc-100"
411	                          : "text-[#424242] hover:bg-[#e8e7e5] hover:text-[#1f1f1f] dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-white/[0.045] dark:hover:text-zinc-100",
412	                      )}
413	                    >
414	                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
415	                        <div className="min-w-0 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
416	                          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2">
417	                            <span className="inline-flex h-5 w-3 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
418	                              {showAwaitingUserIndicator && statusIndicatorLabel ? (
419	                                <span
420	                                  className="inline-flex h-4 w-4 items-center justify-center text-amber-500"
421	                                  aria-label={statusIndicatorLabel}
422	                                  role="img"
423	                                  title={statusIndicatorLabel}
424	                                >
425	                                  <TriangleAlert className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
426	                                </span>
427	                              ) : null}
428	                              {showCompletedAttentionIndicator && statusIndicatorLabel && !showAwaitingUserIndicator ? (
429	                                <span
430	                                  className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-sky-300"
431	                                  aria-label={statusIndicatorLabel}
432	                                  role="img"
433	                                  title={statusIndicatorLabel}
434	                                />
435	                              ) : null}
436	                            </span>
437	                            <span
438	                              className={cn("inline-flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border", visualConfig.className)}
439	                              title={t("conversation.sidebar.conversationVisual", { kind: visualConfig.label })}
440	                              aria-label={t("conversation.sidebar.conversationVisual", { kind: visualConfig.label })}
441	                            >
442	                              {visualKind === "direct" ? (
443	                                <CliBrandIcon workerType={run.preferredWorkerType ?? null} className={run.preferredWorkerType === "opencode" ? "h-3 w-3" : "h-3.5 w-3.5"} />
444	                              ) : (
445	                                <ConversationIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
446	                              )}
447	                            </span>
448	                            {renamingRunId === run.id && renameSource !== "topbar" ? (
449	                              <Input
450	                                value={renameValue}
451	                                onChange={(event) => setRenameValue(event.target.value)}
452	                                onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
453	                                onKeyDown={(event) => {
454	                                  event.stopPropagation();
455	                                  if (event.key === "Enter") {
456	                                    event.preventDefault();
457	                                    commitRenamingRun(run.id);
458	                                  } else if (event.key === "Escape") {
459	                                    event.preventDefault();
460	                                    cancelRenamingRun();
461	                                  }
462	                                }}
463	                                onBlur={() => commitRenamingRun(run.id)}
464	                                autoFocus
465	                                className="h-7 min-w-0 text-[13px]"
466	                              />
467	                            ) : (
468	                              <span className="truncate text-[13px]">{run.title}</span>
469	                            )}
470	                          </div>
471	                          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
472	                            {run.status === "running" ? (
473	                              <LoaderCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground motion-reduce:animate-none" />
474	                            ) : null}
475	                            {runIsUnread && !showCompletedAttentionIndicator ? (
476	                              <div className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />
477	                            ) : null}
478	                            {canArchiveConversation && isCommitConversation ? (
479	                              <Button
480	                                variant="ghost"
481	                                size="icon"
482	                                className="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground opacity-100 hover:text-foreground lg:opacity-0 lg:group-hover:opacity-100"
483	                                aria-label={t("conversation.sidebar.archiveConversation", { title: run.title })}
484	                                title={t("conversation.sidebar.archiveConversation", { title: run.title })}
485	                                onClick={(event) => {
486	                                  event.stopPropagation();
487	                                  archiveRun(run);
488	                                }}
489	                              >
490	                                <Archive className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
491	                              </Button>
492	                            ) : null}
493	                            <DropdownMenu>
494	                              <DropdownMenuTrigger
495	                                onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
496	                                className="inline-flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground opacity-100 transition-colors ring-offset-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 lg:opacity-0 lg:group-hover:opacity-100"
497	                                aria-label={t("conversation.sidebar.conversationActions", { title: run.title })}
498	                              >
499	                                <MoreHorizontal className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
500	                              </DropdownMenuTrigger>
501	                              <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="min-w-28">
502	                                <DropdownMenuItem
503	                                  className="cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
504	                                  onClick={(event) => {
505	                                    event.stopPropagation();
506	                                    startRenamingRun(run);
507	                                  }}
508	                                >
509	                                  <Pencil className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("conversation.sidebar.rename")}
510	                                </DropdownMenuItem>
511	                                {canMoveConversation ? (
512	                                  <DropdownMenuItem
513	                                    className="cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
514	                                    onClick={(event) => {
515	                                      event.stopPropagation();
516	                                      startMovingRun(run);
517	                                    }}
518	                                  >
519	                                    <FolderInput className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("conversation.sidebar.moveToProject")}
520	                                  </DropdownMenuItem>
521	                                ) : null}
522	                                {canArchiveConversation ? (
523	                                  <DropdownMenuItem
524	                                    className="cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
525	                                    onClick={(event) => {
526	                                      event.stopPropagation();
527	                                      archiveRun(run);
528	                                    }}
529	                                  >
530	                                    <Archive className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("conversation.sidebar.archive")}
531	                                  </DropdownMenuItem>
532	                                ) : null}
533	                                <DropdownMenuItem
534	                                  variant="destructive"
535	                                  className="cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
536	                                  onClick={(event) => {
537	                                    event.stopPropagation();
538	                                    deleteRun(run);
539	                                  }}
540	                                >
541	                                  <Trash2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("conversation.sidebar.delete")}
542	                                </DropdownMenuItem>
543	                              </DropdownMenuContent>
544	                            </DropdownMenu>
545	                          </div>
546	                        </div>
547	                      </div>
548	                    </div>
549	                  );
550	                })}
551	                {hiddenSessionCount > 0 ? (
552	                  <button
553	                    type="button"
554	                    className="ml-7 mt-1 inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded-md px-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted/60 hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
555	                    aria-label={t("conversation.sidebar.showMoreSessions", {
556	                      count: nextSessionBatchCount,
557	                      project: group.name,
558	                    })}
559	                    title={t("conversation.sidebar.showMoreSessions", {
560	                      count: nextSessionBatchCount,
561	                      project: group.name,
562	                    })}
563	                    onClick={() => onShowMoreProjectSessions(group.path)}
564	                  >
565	                    {t("conversation.sidebar.moreSessions")}
566	                  </button>
567	                ) : null}
568	              </div>
569	            </div>
570	          </Collapsible>
571	        );
572	      })}
573	    </>
574	  );
575	}

577	interface MoveRunToProjectDialogProps {
578	  open: boolean;
579	  moveRunProjectPath: string;
580	  moveRunToProjectOptions: string[];
581	  isMoveRunToProjectPending: boolean;
582	  setMoveRunProjectPath: (value: string) => void;
583	  confirmMoveRunToProject: () => void;
584	  cancelMovingRun: () => void;
585	}
586	
587	function MoveRunToProjectDialog({
588	  open,
589	  moveRunProjectPath,
590	  moveRunToProjectOptions,
591	  isMoveRunToProjectPending,
592	  setMoveRunProjectPath,
593	  confirmMoveRunToProject,
594	  cancelMovingRun,
595	}: MoveRunToProjectDialogProps) {
596	  return (
597	    <Dialog
598	      open={open}
599	      onOpenChange={(nextOpen) => {
600	        if (!nextOpen) {
601	          cancelMovingRun();
602	        }
603	      }}
604	    >
605	      <DialogContent showCloseButton={false}>
606	        <DialogHeader>
607	          <DialogTitle>{t("conversation.moveProject.title")}</DialogTitle>
608	          <DialogDescription>
609	            {moveRunToProjectOptions.length > 0
610	              ? t("conversation.moveProject.description")
611	              : t("conversation.moveProject.empty")}
612	          </DialogDescription>
613	        </DialogHeader>
614	        <div className="grid gap-2">
615	          <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" htmlFor="move-run-project-select">
616	            {t("conversation.moveProject.projectLabel")}
617	          </label>
618	          <select
619	            id="move-run-project-select"
620	            className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 text-sm text-foreground shadow-xs outline-none transition-colors focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
621	            value={moveRunProjectPath}
622	            onChange={(event) => setMoveRunProjectPath(event.target.value)}
623	            disabled={isMoveRunToProjectPending || moveRunToProjectOptions.length === 0}
624	          >
625	            <option value="">{t("conversation.moveProject.placeholder")}</option>
626	            {moveRunToProjectOptions.map((projectPath) => (
627	              <option key={projectPath} value={projectPath}>
628	                {projectPath}
629	              </option>
630	            ))}
631	          </select>
632	        </div>
633	        <DialogFooter>
634	          <Button
635	            type="button"
636	            variant="outline"
637	            onClick={cancelMovingRun}
638	            disabled={isMoveRunToProjectPending}
639	          >
640	            {t("common.cancel")}
641	          </Button>
642	          <Button
643	            type="button"
644	            onClick={confirmMoveRunToProject}
645	            disabled={!moveRunProjectPath || isMoveRunToProjectPending}
646	          >
647	            {t("conversation.moveProject.ok")}
648	          </Button>
649	        </DialogFooter>
650	      </DialogContent>
651	    </Dialog>
652	  );
653	}

665	  readMarkers: Record<string, string>;

703	  onCollapse?: () => void;
704	  onOpenExternalSessions?: () => void;
705	  runnerControlsMode?: "desktop" | "mobile";
706	}

708	export function ConversationSidebar({
709	  filteredProjects,
710	  activeProjects,
711	  conversationSidebarTab,
712	  setConversationSidebarTab,

714	  searchQuery,
715	  setSearchQuery,
716	  selectedRunId,
717	  messages,
718	  readMarkers,
719	  collapsedProjectPaths,
720	  visibleProjectSessionCounts,
721	  onProjectOpenChange,
722	  onReorderProjects,
723	  onCollapseAllProjects,
724	  onShowMoreProjectSessions,
725	  setShowSettings,
726	  openOnboarding,
727	  openFolderPicker,
728	  startNewPlan,
729	  beginConversationInProject,
730	  autoCommitProject,
731	  isAutoCommitProjectPending,
732	  handleRemoveProject,
733	  selectRun,
734	  renamingRunId,
735	  renameValue,
736	  renameSource,
737	  setRenameValue,
738	  movingRunId,
739	  moveRunProjectPath,
740	  moveRunToProjectOptions,
741	  setMoveRunProjectPath,
742	  startMovingRun,
743	  confirmMoveRunToProject,
744	  cancelMovingRun,
745	  isMoveRunToProjectPending,
746	  startRenamingRun,
747	  commitRenamingRun,
748	  cancelRenamingRun,
749	  archiveRun,
750	  deleteRun,
751	  authEnabled,
752	  openPairDeviceDialog,
753	  logout,
754	  themeMode,
755	  setThemeMode,
756	  onCollapse,
757	  onOpenExternalSessions,
758	  runnerControlsMode = "desktop",
759	}: ConversationSidebarProps) {
760	  useI18nSnapshot();
761	  const themeModeLabel = t(themeMode === "night" ? "theme.mode.switchDay" : "theme.mode.switchNight");
762	  const visibleProjectGroups = conversationSidebarTab === "projects" ? filteredProjects : activeProjects;
763	  const hasExpandedVisibleProjectGroup = visibleProjectGroups.some((group) => !collapsedProjectPaths.has(group.path));
764	  const mounted = useSyncExternalStore(
765	    useCallback((listener) => conversationSidebarHydrationManager.subscribe(listener), []),
766	    useCallback(() => conversationSidebarHydrationManager.getSnapshot(), []),
767	    () => conversationSidebarHydrationManager.getSnapshot(),
768	  );
769	  useEffect(() => {
770	    conversationSidebarHydrationManager.markMounted();
771	  }, []);
772	
773	  if (!mounted) {
774	    // First render (SSR + initial client paint) renders an empty shell so the
775	    // client tree shape matches the server's. Without this, the project/run
776	    // list populates from local state after hydration, shifting Base UI's
777	    // auto-generated IDs and producing a hydration mismatch warning across
778	    // every DropdownMenuTrigger in the sidebar.
779	    return (
780	      <div
781	        className="relative flex h-full min-h-0 w-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#f1f1f0] dark:bg-muted/30"
782	        aria-hidden="true"
783	      />
784	    );
785	  }
786	
787	  return (
788	    <div className="relative flex h-full min-h-0 w-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#f1f1f0] dark:bg-muted/30">
789	      <div className="space-y-1 px-3 pb-3 pt-2 lg:px-3 lg:pb-3 lg:pt-2">
790	        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
791	          <div className="hidden min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2 lg:flex">
792	            <OmniHarnessMark className="h-8 w-8" />
793	            <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-[#333333] dark:text-zinc-100">
794	              {PRODUCT_NAME}
795	            </span>
796	          </div>
797	          {onCollapse ? (
798	            <Button
799	              variant="ghost"
800	              size="icon"
801	              className="hidden h-9 w-9 text-[#333333]/75 transition-all duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-[#deddda] hover:text-[#1f1f1f] lg:inline-flex dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-muted/70 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 motion-reduce:transition-none"
802	              aria-label={t("conversation.sidebar.collapseAria")}
803	              title={t("conversation.sidebar.collapseAria")}
804	              onClick={onCollapse}
805	            >
806	              <PanelLeftClose className="h-4 w-4 transition-transform duration-150 ease-out group-hover/button:-translate-x-0.5 motion-reduce:transition-none" />
807	            </Button>
808	          ) : null}
809	        </div>
810	        <RunnerControls
811	          placement="sidebar"
812	          controlId={runnerControlsMode === "mobile" ? "runner-switcher-mobile" : "runner-switcher"}
813	          renderDialogs={runnerControlsMode === "desktop"}
814	        />
815	        <div className="flex items-stretch gap-0">
816	          <Button variant="ghost" className="h-9 min-w-0 flex-1 justify-start px-2 text-sm text-[#333333] hover:bg-[#deddda] hover:text-[#1f1f1f] dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-muted/70 dark:hover:text-zinc-100" onClick={startNewPlan}>
817	            <Plus className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" /> {t("conversation.sidebar.newSession")}
818	          </Button>
819	          {onOpenExternalSessions && (
820	            <DropdownMenu>
821	              <DropdownMenuTrigger
822	                className="inline-flex h-9 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-[#333333]/60 transition-colors hover:bg-[#deddda] hover:text-[#1f1f1f] focus-visible:outline-none dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-muted/70 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
823	                aria-label={t("externalSessions.moreOptionsAria")}
824	              >
825	                <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
826	              </DropdownMenuTrigger>
827	              <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-52">
828	                <DropdownMenuItem className="cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" onClick={onOpenExternalSessions}>
829	                  <SquareTerminal className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" /> {t("externalSessions.title")}
830	                </DropdownMenuItem>
831	              </DropdownMenuContent>
832	            </DropdownMenu>
833	          )}
834	        </div>
835	        <div className="relative">
836	          <Search className="absolute left-2 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-[#333333] dark:text-zinc-300" />
837	          <Input
838	            type="text"
839	            placeholder={t("conversation.sidebar.searchPlaceholder")}
840	            value={searchQuery}
841	            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
842	            className="h-9 w-full border-transparent bg-[#e4e3e1] pl-8 text-sm text-[#333333] transition-all placeholder:text-[#333333]/75 hover:bg-[#deddda] focus-visible:border-[#c8c7c5] focus-visible:bg-[#e4e3e1] focus-visible:ring-1 dark:bg-white/[0.08] dark:text-zinc-100 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-white/[0.095] dark:focus-visible:bg-white/[0.08]"
843	          />
844	        </div>
845	      </div>
846	
847	      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden">
848	        <ScrollArea className="h-full px-3">
849	          <div className="space-y-3 pb-4 pt-0.5">
850	          <div className="ml-2 mr-1 flex items-center justify-between">
851	            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
852	              <button
853	                type="button"
854	                onClick={() => setConversationSidebarTab("projects")}
855	                className={cn(

## Claude tool result: toolu_01GXRKaKi8mkFyUAW2dXBNTb · 2026-08-05T10:30:10.980Z

````text
1	# Hot-Path Responsiveness and Resource Leaks
2	
3	> Incident notes and permanent rules from the May 2026 worker-streaming latency
4	> failure. The lesson is blunt: the app must serve the page and control-plane
5	> hot paths even while workers, supervisors, bridge polling, and persistence are
6	> busy.
7	
8	## Why This Exists
9	
10	On May 20, 2026 the local app repeatedly became unresponsive while a supervisor
11	process was managing a long-running worker. Chrome showed hard reloads stuck in
12	`pending`, and server logs showed request times that are unacceptable for a
13	control plane:
14	
15	```text
16	GET /api/events?runId=ca18b7e86437 200 in 55543ms
17	GET /api/events?snapshot=1&persisted=1&runId=70a589b48ba5... 200 in 103695ms
18	GET /api/workers/70a589b48ba5-worker-2/entries?afterSeq=0 200 in 80421ms
19	```
20	
21	Later live evidence was worse:
22	
23	```text
24	GET /api/events?runId=ca18b7e86437 200 in 487273ms
25	GET / 200 in 325220ms
26	GET /api/workers/ca18b7e86437-worker-3/entries?afterSeq=250 401 in 62700ms
27	```
28	
29	Another reload failure exposed the same class of bug through optional catalog
30	work:
31	
32	```text
33	GET /api/agents/catalog 200 in 65581ms
34	GET /api/agents/catalog 200 in 122868ms
35	GET / 200 in 130440ms
36	GET /session/8ad0c5c3f219 200 in 130473ms
37	```
38	
39	This was not a cosmetic frontend problem. The server was failing the basic
40	product promise: serve the page, show current state, and keep worker streams
41	usable while work is running.
42	
43	## Symptoms We Observed
44	
45	- Hard reloads and normal reloads could sit in Chrome's Network tab as
46	  `pending` instead of returning the HTML shell.
47	- Worker stream polling became slower as workers produced more transcript
48	  content.
49	- `/api/events` snapshots took tens of seconds to minutes.
50	- `/api/agents/catalog` could spend more than a minute on worker/model
51	  discovery while the user was only trying to load an existing conversation.
52	- The Next dev process repeatedly printed `[db] schema ready`, which was a sign
53	  that request/module evaluation was reopening DB-backed modules.
54	- A contaminated long-running dev process held dozens of sqlite-related file
55	  descriptors. In the live incident, the old Next process held 34 sqlite FDs.
56	- The app appeared worse with supervisor-driven worker turns because the
57	  supervisor increased worker-history reads, bridge polling, event snapshots,
58	  and worker stream traffic.
59	
60	## Root Causes
61	
62	### 1. Snapshots Included Worker Transcript Bodies
63	
64	Persisted event bootstrap and snapshot payloads loaded worker entries directly
65	from disk and included them in `workerEntries`. That meant a page reload or
66	`/api/events?snapshot=1&persisted=1` could walk large worker transcripts before
67	responding.
68	
69	Snapshots need cursors, not transcript bodies. The worker stream endpoint is
70	the content authority.
71	
72	### 2. Worker Stream Reads Were Full-File Reads
73	
74	`GET /api/workers/:workerId/entries?afterSeq=N` could fall back to reading and
75	parsing the whole JSONL transcript even when the client only needed entries
76	after a recent cursor. As a worker transcript grew, every poll became more
77	expensive.
78	
79	Incremental reads must use the JSONL tail for `afterSeq > 0` and only fall
80	back to canonical full reads for legacy, compressed, corrupt, or first-load
81	cases.
82	
83	### 3. Worker Stream Writes Rebuilt Caches On Every Append
84	
85	The writer assigned seqs and deduplicated bridge entries by rebuilding the
86	seen-id/fingerprint state from the full JSONL file on each append. Streaming
87	assistant text made this especially bad: each new chunk paid the cost of all
88	previous chunks.
89	
90	The normal append path must be O(new entries), not O(transcript history). The
91	writer cache is allowed to rebuild from disk on first use after process start
92	or when file stats prove another writer touched the file.
93	
94	### 4. Hot Routes Imported DB-Backed Modules Too Early
95	
96	Some unauthenticated or no-cookie paths imported modules that immediately
97	created DB clients and initialized schema, even though the request could have
98	returned without touching sqlite. This happened on routes like worker entries
99	and auth/session bootstrap.
100	
101	Hot-path imports are part of runtime behavior. A top-level import of a DB
102	module is a DB dependency for every request that loads that route module.
103	
104	### 5. DB Client State Was Not Stable Across Module Re-Evaluation
105	
106	Next dev and runtime module re-evaluation can reload server modules. A DB client
107	created as a plain module singleton is not necessarily a process singleton in
108	that environment. Repeated evaluation created more sqlite clients and handles.
109	
110	Resource singletons in the dev server must be process-scoped and keyed by the
111	actual resource path.
112	
113	### 6. Page SSR Blocked On Too Much Application State
114	
115	The root page SSR path built a rich bootstrap payload that could include auth
116	state, settings, and event snapshots. That made "serve HTML" depend on the same
117	slow paths as "hydrate full app state".
118	
119	The page must return a shell quickly. Runtime bootstrap, settings, event
120	snapshots, and worker transcripts are client/runtime follow-up requests.
121	
122	### 7. Root Client Bundle Compilation Could Block HTML In Dev
123	
124	Even after server bootstrap was narrowed, the root page imported the entire
125	`HomeApp` client graph up front. In Next dev, compiling that graph could block
126	the first HTML response for the page, especially while the server was already
127	under load.
128	
129	The shell must be small. Heavy app graphs can load behind a dynamic client
130	boundary with an immediate boot shell.
131	
132	### 8. Catalog Discovery Was Treated As Load-Bearing State
133	
134	The frontend eagerly requested `/api/agents/catalog` during app bootstrap and
135	conversation reloads, even though catalog data is optional metadata for
136	onboarding, settings, and explicit refresh. The route could also perform
137	blocking local CLI availability probes. When a CLI probe or login shell stalled,
138	conversation load stalled behind work that was unrelated to rendering the
139	selected transcript.
140	
141	Catalog discovery must be demand-driven and bounded. Existing conversations can
142	render from persisted run/worker metadata and cached/static worker definitions;
143	they must not wait for fresh worker availability, model discovery, or CLI health
144	checks.
145	
146	## Fixes That Addressed The Incident
147	
148	- Persisted snapshots now publish `workerEntrySeqs` instead of `workerEntries`.
149	- Snapshot builders use `readWorkerLatestSeq()` rather than
150	  `readWorkerEntriesSince(..., 0)` for worker cursor hints.
151	- Worker entry reads use a bounded JSONL tail reader for incremental cursors.
152	- Worker entry writes keep next-seq, seen ids, fingerprints, and file state in
153	  a per-worker cache and only rebuild when file stats change.
154	- API auth checks return missing-auth responses before dynamically importing
155	  DB-backed session code.
156	- API session caching is TTL-bounded and size-bounded.
157	- `buildAuthSessionState()` returns unauthenticated no-cookie state before
158	  importing DB-backed session code.
159	- DB state is cached on `process` in a path-keyed map so repeated module
160	  evaluation reuses the same sqlite client for the same DB path.
161	- Home SSR calls `buildRuntimeBootstrap({ includeInitialData: false })`.
162	- The root `OmniApp` dynamically imports the heavy `HomeApp` client graph and
163	  renders `BootShell` while it loads.
164	- The home bootstrap path no longer fetches `/api/agents/catalog` on page load,
165	  app unlock, focus, or conversation selection.
166	- Catalog requests are reserved for onboarding, Agents settings, and explicit
167	  manual refresh. Conversation rendering uses persisted run/worker data and
168	  cached/static catalog fallbacks.
169	- The catalog API avoids blocking local CLI probes in the frontend request path
170	  and returns degraded-but-useful data when live availability is slow.
171	
172	## Verification Evidence From The Fix
173	
174	Automated verification:
175	
176	- Focused hot-path suite:
177	  `tests/api/auth-guard-cache.test.ts`,
178	  `tests/api/worker-entries-hot-path.test.ts`,
179	  `tests/ui/ssr-bootstrap.test.ts`,
180	  `tests/api/conversation-load-coverage.test.ts`,
181	  `tests/api/events-route.test.ts`,
182	  `tests/api/runtime-bootstrap-route.test.ts`, and
183	  `tests/server/workers/output-store.test.ts`.
184	- Lifecycle suite: `pnpm test:lifecycle`.
185	- ESLint over touched hot-path files.
186	
187	Live clean-process validation after the fixes:
188	
189	```text
190	Next ready: 3.7s
191	Initial / prewarm: 9775ms
192	Initial persisted event snapshot prewarm: 5514ms
193	Initial worker entries after route compile: 410-445ms
194	Steady /: 329-490ms
195	Steady /api/auth/session: 398-548ms
196	Steady worker entries auth miss: 416-597ms
197	sqlite FDs: stable at 4
198	```
199	
200	The old contaminated process had 34 sqlite-related FDs and request times in the
201	tens of seconds to minutes. The clean process after the fix stayed at 4 sqlite
202	FDs and returned steady hot-path requests in under a second.
203	
204	## Permanent Rules
205	
206	### Rule 1: The Page Shell Must Be Cheap
207	
208	The root page may parse route params and produce a minimal shell bootstrap. It
209	must not synchronously load:
210	
211	- persisted event snapshots,
212	- full settings state,
213	- worker transcripts,
214	- bridge catalogs,
215	- supervisor/recovery reconciliation,
216	- project memory,
217	- external health probes.
218	
219	If a future feature needs those, load them through runtime APIs after the shell
220	has been served.
221	
222	### Rule 2: Snapshots Carry Cursors, Not Large Bodies
223	
224	Event snapshots can include compact metadata and cursor hints. They must not
225	inline append-only content such as worker transcript bodies. For workers, the
226	snapshot contract is `workerEntrySeqs`; content comes from
227	`GET /api/workers/:workerId/entries?afterSeq=N`.
228	
229	### Rule 3: Hot Reads Must Be Bounded
230	
231	For any endpoint that is called during boot, reload, reconnect, polling, or
232	stream wake-up:
233	
234	- read from a bounded cursor, tail, cache, or compact read model;
235	- set short timeouts around external dependencies;
236	- return degraded but useful responses when optional state is unavailable;
237	- never wait on bridge health checks or reconciliation writes.
238	
239	A 25 second hot-path request is a control-plane failure even if it eventually
240	returns 200.
241	
242	### Rule 4: Streaming Appends Must Not Reprocess History
243	
244	Worker stream append cost must scale with the new entries being appended, not
245	with all historical entries in the transcript. Full transcript scans are only
246	allowed for:
247	
248	- first cache seed after process start,
249	- detected external file mutation,
250	- compaction/expansion/repair,
251	- explicit maintenance scripts.
252	
253	Normal bridge polling and streaming token updates must not parse the whole
254	worker file.
255	
256	### Rule 5: Top-Level Imports Count As Hot-Path Work
257	
258	If a route can return before touching the DB, bridge, file system, or a heavy
259	module graph, its top-level imports must preserve that property. Use dynamic
260	imports after cheap gates such as method checks, auth cookie presence, and
261	parameter validation.
262	
263	This is especially important for:
264	
265	- auth guards,
266	- session bootstrap,
267	- worker entries,
268	- event snapshots,
269	- settings and catalog routes.
270	
271	### Rule 6: Resource Singletons Must Be Process-Scoped And Keyed
272	
273	Local dev can re-evaluate modules. Do not assume a module-level `const client`
274	is enough for scarce resources. DB clients, lock managers, and other process
275	resources should be cached on `process` or another true process-level owner and
276	keyed by the path/URL they represent.
277	
278	For sqlite, watch FD counts during live validation. A healthy dev web process
279	should not accumulate new sqlite FDs as routes are requested.
280	
281	### Rule 7: Caches Must Be Bounded
282	
283	Every process-local cache introduced to protect a hot path needs an explicit
284	bound:
285	
286	- TTL, size, or both;
287	- key space with known cardinality;
288	- invalidation behavior for writes or external mutation;
289	- test coverage for eviction or no-growth behavior.
290	
291	Do not trade a DB leak for an unbounded memory cache.
292	
293	### Rule 8: Dev Prewarm Must Not Mask Broken Hot Paths
294	
295	Prewarm can make the first interactive page nicer, but it is not a correctness
296	fix. If prewarm takes tens of seconds or blocks other requests, that is still a
297	bug. Use prewarm logs as performance evidence, not as a place to hide slow
298	routes.
299	
300	### Rule 9: Catalogs Are Demand-Driven Metadata
301	
302	Worker catalogs, model catalogs, provider availability, CLI health, and project
303	file indexes are not conversation-load prerequisites. They may support chooser
304	menus, onboarding, diagnostics, and settings pages, but the selected
305	conversation must render without waiting for them.
306	
307	Default cadence:
308	
309	- do not fetch `/api/agents/catalog` during root page bootstrap, route
310	  selection, app unlock, or focus restore;
311	- fetch catalog data when the user opens onboarding or Agents settings, or when
312	  the user explicitly refreshes runtime availability;
313	- use cached or static definitions while a fresh catalog refresh is pending;
314	- put short timeouts around live probes and return partial results instead of
315	  serializing the request queue behind a hung local CLI;
316	- keep project file indexing behind file mention/search intent, not general app
317	  load.
318	
319	### Rule 10: Test The Failure Shape Directly
320	
321	Every future change touching boot, snapshots, auth guards, worker streams, or
322	resource ownership should include at least one targeted assertion from this
323	list:
324	
325	- unauthenticated hot path returns before importing DB-backed modules;
326	- snapshot payload does not contain worker transcript bodies;
327	- worker append cache does not rebuild from disk on every streaming append;
328	- incremental worker reads are served from the JSONL tail;
329	- DB clients are process/path scoped;
330	- page bootstrap calls `includeInitialData: false`;
331	- root page does not synchronously import the heavy app graph;
332	- conversation load and home bootstrap do not eagerly request
333	  `/api/agents/catalog` or project file indexes.
334	
335	## Review Checklist For Future PRs
336	
337	Use this checklist before merging any change near the control plane:
338	
339	- Does this route run on page load, reload, reconnect, SSE wake-up, polling, or
340	  worker streaming cadence?
341	- What are its top-level imports, and do any of them open DB handles, start
342	  schema initialization, read large files, or probe the bridge?
343	- Is this request optional metadata such as catalog, model, availability, or
344	  file-index data? If so, why is it on the current hot path?
345	- Is the worst-case read bounded by a cursor, tail window, limit, or cache?
346	- Can it return a degraded response if optional state is slow?
347	- Does it include append-only bodies in a broad snapshot?
348	- Does it create a process-local cache, and is that cache bounded?
349	- Does it create a scarce resource, and is that resource owned by a stable
350	  process-level singleton?
351	- What command proves it does not regress?
352	- What live metric should stay flat: sqlite FDs, RSS, response time, or all
353	  three?
354	
355	## Commands We Used To Diagnose
356	
357	Run lookup:
358	
359	```bash
360	sqlite3 sqlite.db "select id,status,mode,title,updated_at from runs where id = '<runId>';"
361	sqlite3 sqlite.db "select id,run_id,type,status,bridge_session_id,worker_number,updated_at from workers where run_id = '<runId>' order by updated_at desc;"
362	sqlite3 sqlite.db "select event_type,worker_id,created_at,substr(details,1,200) from execution_events where run_id = '<runId>' order by created_at desc limit 20;"
363	```
364	
365	Process and sqlite FD checks:
366	
367	```bash
368	ps -axo pid,ppid,rss,pcpu,etime,command | rg 'next-server|scripts/dev|remote-restart' | rg -v rg
369	PID=$(lsof -tiTCP:3050 -sTCP:LISTEN | head -n1)
370	ps -o pid=,rss=,pcpu=,etime=,command= -p "$PID"
371	lsof -p "$PID" 2>/dev/null | rg 'sqlite.db($|-wal|-shm)' | wc -l
372	```
373	
374	Bounded live request checks:
375	
376	```bash
377	curl --max-time 10 -sS -o /tmp/omni-root.out -w 'root status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1:3035/
378	curl --max-time 10 -sS -o /tmp/omni-auth.out -w 'auth status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1:3035/api/auth/session
379	curl --max-time 10 -sS -o /tmp/omni-worker.out -w 'worker status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}\n' 'http://127.0.0.1:3035/api/workers/<workerId>/entries?afterSeq=0'
380	```
381	
382	Use bounded checks. Do not run unbounded stress loops on a machine already
383	showing memory pressure or UI instability.
384	
385	## Tests That Guard This Class
386	
387	- `tests/ui/ssr-bootstrap.test.ts` checks that the page bootstrap avoids
388	  persisted snapshots, that worker/auth hot paths avoid eager DB imports, and
389	  that the heavy `HomeApp` graph is dynamically loaded.
390	- `tests/api/worker-entries-hot-path.test.ts` checks that the common
391	  run-id-derived worker entries route can serve without importing DB/schema and
392	  that missing auth returns before DB-backed work.
393	- `tests/api/auth-guard-cache.test.ts` checks that API session validation is
394	  reused and bounded.
395	- `tests/server/workers/output-store.test.ts` checks tail reads, latest-seq
396	  reads, write cache behavior, external file mutation refresh, append/compaction
397	  ordering, and crash-truncated lines.
398	- `tests/api/events-route.test.ts` checks snapshot shape and event behavior.
399	- `tests/app/home-queries-catalog.test.ts` checks that home bootstrap does not
400	  eagerly fetch catalog or project file data and only does so for explicit
401	  user-facing catalog/file workflows.
402	- `pnpm test:lifecycle` checks reconnect, restart, failover, recovery, delete,
403	  and process-session behavior over HTTP/SSE.
404	
405	## Anti-Patterns To Refuse
406	
407	- "Just include the entries in the snapshot so the frontend has everything."
408	- "This route only imports the DB; it does not query until later."
409	- "The full JSONL read is fine because files are small right now."
410	- "Prewarm will hide the slow first request."
411	- "A process-local cache is small enough without a limit."
412	- "Dev-only slowness is acceptable for the control plane."
413	- "The worker is running, so a reload can wait."
414	- "We need fresh worker availability before showing an existing conversation."
415	- "Fetching the catalog on focus is harmless because the response is cached."
416	
417	The worker may be running for hours. The page still has to serve.
418	
419	## May 22, 2026 — Recurrence and Fixes
420	
421	Same class of failure resurfaced after weeks of stability. Symptoms from the
422	running dev stack:
423	
424	```text
425	GET /api/settings 200 in 47865ms
426	POST /api/agents/prewarm-worker 500 in 86165ms   (bridge ECONNRESET)
427	POST /api/agents/prewarm-worker 500 in 123530ms  (bridge not_found after restart)
428	GET /api/workers/<id>/entries?afterSeq=0 200 in 41086ms
429	```
430	
431	Once one route blocked the event loop, every concurrent request piled up
432	behind it, including auth-rejected calls that never reach a handler.
433	
434	### Root causes found
435	
436	1. **`/api/settings` GET ran `canonicalizePersistedProjectRoots` on every
437	   poll.** That helper iterates all runs + all workers, does sync
438	   `fs.existsSync` per run, and serial `db.update` per drifted row. With a
439	   large run history and React Query plus SSE reconnect both polling
440	   settings, this saturated the loop for tens of seconds. Canonicalization
441	   only matters when `PROJECTS` changes — which only happens on `POST`.
442	
443	2. **`readEntriesByKey` (in `src/server/workers/output-store.ts`) was an
444	   unbounded Map.** Each value is the full parsed transcript for one
445	   `(runId, workerId)` chain. A supervisor cycling through many workers
446	   kept every transcript ever read resident.
447	
448	3. **`readWorkerEntriesSinceJsonlTail` did quadratic re-parsing.** Each
449	   "after-seq" tail call re-read and re-parsed back from end of file
450	   looking for the cutoff, growing with transcript size.
451	
452	4. **`seenIdsByKey` / `fingerprintsByKey` / `nextSeqByKey` / `fileStateByKey`
453	   write-side chain caches were also unbounded.** Same shape — one entry
454	   per `(runId, workerId)`, only cleared on file deletion. A long-running
455	   supervisor that cycles workers but never deletes their files leaks
456	   forever. Worst offenders are `seenIdsByKey` (one string per persisted
457	   entry id) and `fingerprintsByKey` (one map per id).
458	
459	### Fixes landed
460	
461	- `src/runtime/http/routes/settings.ts` — removed the
462	  `canonicalizePersistedProjectRoots` call from the GET path. POST still
463	  canonicalizes on `PROJECTS` writes, which is the only moment it matters.
464	- `src/server/workers/output-store.ts` —
465	  - `readEntriesByKey`: LRU-bounded to 32 chains via insertion-order
466	    eviction + cache-hit "touch" (`setReadEntriesCache` /
467	    `touchReadEntriesCache`).
468	  - `readWorkerEntriesSinceJsonlTail`: rewritten to read at most 1 MB from
469	    the tail in a single `fs.read`, parse once, return the entries past
470	    `afterSeq`. Falls back to the legacy backward scan only when the 1 MB
471	    window can't prove the cutoff.
472	  - Write-side chain caches: LRU-bounded to 64 chains shared across
473	    `seenIdsByKey` / `fingerprintsByKey` / `nextSeqByKey` /
474	    `fileStateByKey` (`rememberChainKey`). Eviction is safe — the next
475	    `refreshChainCaches` call rebuilds from disk + DB-tracked
476	    `latestSeq`.
477	
478	### Tests added
479	
480	`tests/server/workers/output-store.test.ts` — new `output-store cache
481	memory bounds` block proves the caps hold numerically under simulated
482	multi-worker stress:
483	
484	- 80 worker chains → `readEntriesByKey.size ≤ 32`
485	- 120 worker chains → `seenIdsByKey` / `fingerprintsByKey` /
486	  `nextSeqByKey` each `≤ 64`
487	- Hot worker stays cached through 100 cold worker churn (no extra disk
488	  refreshes after the LRU is full)
489	
490	These act as a regression gate: any future commit that re-introduces an
491	unbounded cache fails CI.
492	
493	### Verification under live multi-worker load
494	
495	After restart (dev stack restarted under `nohup`) with all four ACP
496	binaries on PATH (`claude-agent-acp`, `codex-acp`, `gemini`, `opencode`),
497	exercised the bridge directly at `:7800` to simulate a supervisor:
498	
499	```text
500	# Concurrent prewarm of all 4 worker types
501	claude:   200 0.15s
502	codex:    200 0.69s
503	gemini:   200 14.91s   (gemini-cli's inherent startup, not a regression)
504	opencode: 200 16.25s
505	
506	# Bridge /agents responsiveness during prewarm: 2-7ms
507	
508	# 3 concurrent claude agents spawned + each handed a real Claude API
509	# round-trip via POST /agents/<name>/ask
510	spawn-w1: 201 0.14s
511	spawn-w2: 201 1.82s
512	spawn-w3: 201 1.69s
513	
514	ask-w1:   200 2.15s  → response: "OK"
515	ask-w2:   200 2.18s  → response: "OK"
516	ask-w3:   200 2.38s  → response: "OK"
517	ask wall: 2.40s for all three concurrent
518	
519	# 10 concurrent /api/settings DURING the ACP message exchanges
520	settings#1..10: 0.93-1.00s each — no degradation
521	
522	# Bridge RSS during/after: 43-52 MB stable across 10 child subprocesses
523	# Web RSS: 1.3 GB stable
524	# User's pre-existing workers (gemini+codex) survived undisturbed
525	# Zero ECONNRESET, zero timeouts
526	```
527	
528	Compared against the failure baseline:
529	
530	| Metric                           | Before fix          | After fix + restart |
531	| -------------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- |
532	| Single `/api/settings`           | 47 s (timeout)      | 0.65-0.95 s         |
533	| `/api/agents/prewarm-worker`     | 86 s → 500 ECONNRESET | 0.15-16.2 s, all 200 |
534	| 30 concurrent `/api/settings`    | (would saturate)    | 1.4 s wall, 1.16-1.32 s each |
535	| 10 concurrent settings DURING ACP traffic | (would crash)    | 0.93-1.00 s each    |
536	| Bridge memory after prewarm+ask  | crashed/restarted   | 43.4 MB stable      |
537	| ECONNRESET under load            | reproducible        | none observed       |
538	
539	### Anti-patterns added (additive to the list above)
540	
541	- "Settings GET is idempotent so we can do fixups inside it." — only the
542	  fixup is idempotent; the cost is per-call. Fixups belong on the writes
543	  that cause drift.
544	- "The chain cache only grows by a few KB per worker." — multiplied by a
545	  supervisor cycling workers for hours, it is unbounded. Every
546	  module-level Map keyed by a per-run-or-worker identifier needs an LRU
547	  cap with a regression test, not a "small enough" assertion.
548	- "If we evict the dedup cache we'll re-append duplicates." — safe iff
549	  eviction triggers a disk + DB re-read of the canonical state on the
550	  next access. Verify that path exists before claiming the cache is
551	  load-bearing.
552

1	// Pure helpers for sidebar activity classification. No React imports.
2	// Used by useHomeViewModel to build the Active tab dataset.
3	
4	import { isTerminalRunStatus, normalizeRunStatus } from "@/lib/run-status";
5	import { isWorkerActiveStatus } from "@/lib/conversation-workers";
6	import { getRunLatestUnreadTimestamp, isRunUnread } from "@/lib/conversation-state";
7	import type { SidebarGroup, SidebarRun } from "./types";

9	export const ACTIVE_SESSION_ACTIVITY_WINDOW_MS = 20 * 60 * 1000;
10	
11	function parseTimestampMs(value: string | null | undefined): number {
12	  if (!value) return 0;
13	  const t = new Date(value).getTime();
14	  return Number.isFinite(t) ? t : 0;
15	}
16	
17	function laterOf(a: string | null | undefined, b: string | null | undefined): string | null {
18	  const aMs = parseTimestampMs(a);
19	  const bMs = parseTimestampMs(b);
20	  if (!a && !b) return null;
21	  return aMs >= bMs ? (a ?? null) : (b ?? null);
22	}
23	
24	function maxTimestamp(...values: (string | null | undefined)[]): string | null {
25	  return values.reduce<string | null>((acc, v) => laterOf(acc, v), null);
26	}
27	
28	// User-authored input rows only — excludes supervisor, internal, checkpoint, intervention
29	function isUserInputMessage(message: { role: string; kind?: string | null }): boolean {
30	  if ((message.role ?? "").toLowerCase() !== "user") return false;
31	  const kind = (message.kind ?? "").toLowerCase();
32	  return kind !== "checkpoint" && kind !== "internal" && kind !== "intervention";
33	}
34	
35	type RunInput = {
36	  id: string;
37	  status: string;
38	  createdAt: string;
39	  updatedAt?: string | null;
40	};
41	
42	type WorkerInput = {
43	  id: string;
44	  runId: string;
45	  status: string;
46	  updatedAt?: string;
47	};
48	
49	type AgentInput = {
50	  name: string; // workerId
51	  state: string;
52	  updatedAt?: string;
53	  lastText?: string;
54	  currentText?: string;
55	  displayText?: string;
56	};
57	
58	type MessageInput = {
59	  runId: string;
60	  role: string;
61	  kind?: string | null;
62	  createdAt: string;
63	};
64	
65	type QueuedMessageInput = {
66	  runId: string;
67	  createdAt: string;
68	  updatedAt: string;
69	  deliveredAt?: string | null;
70	};
71	
72	export interface SidebarRunActivityArgs {
73	  run: RunInput;
74	  messages: MessageInput[];
75	  readMarkers: Record<string, string>;
76	  workers: WorkerInput[];
77	  agents: AgentInput[];
78	  queuedMessages: QueuedMessageInput[];
79	  workerOutputObservedAtByRunId: Record<string, string>;
80	  nowMs: number;
81	  selectedRunId?: string | null;
82	}
83	
84	function getLatestUserInputAt(
85	  runId: string,
86	  messages: MessageInput[],
87	  queuedMessages: QueuedMessageInput[],
88	): string | null {
89	  let latest: string | null = null;
90	
91	  for (const msg of messages) {
92	    if (msg.runId !== runId || !isUserInputMessage(msg)) continue;
93	    if (parseTimestampMs(msg.createdAt) > parseTimestampMs(latest)) {
94	      latest = msg.createdAt;
95	    }
96	  }
97	
98	  for (const qm of queuedMessages) {
99	    if (qm.runId !== runId) continue;
100	    const ts = qm.deliveredAt ?? qm.updatedAt ?? qm.createdAt;
101	    if (parseTimestampMs(ts) > parseTimestampMs(latest)) {
102	      latest = ts;
103	    }
104	  }
105	
106	  return latest;
107	}
108	
109	// recentActivityAt: max of eligible user-input and worker-output signals
110	export function getSidebarRunLastActivityAt(args: SidebarRunActivityArgs): string | null {
111	  const userInputAt = getLatestUserInputAt(args.run.id, args.messages, args.queuedMessages);
112	  const workerOutputAt = args.workerOutputObservedAtByRunId[args.run.id] ?? null;
113	  return maxTimestamp(userInputAt, workerOutputAt);
114	}
115	
116	function getWorkingActivityAt(
117	  args: Pick<SidebarRunActivityArgs, "run" | "workers" | "agents">,
118	): string | null {
119	  const { run, workers, agents } = args;
120	  const runWorkers = workers.filter((w) => w.runId === run.id);
121	  const activeWorkers = runWorkers.filter((w) => isWorkerActiveStatus(w.status));
122	  const runWorkerIds = new Set(runWorkers.map((w) => w.id));
123	  const activeAgents = agents.filter((a) => runWorkerIds.has(a.name) && isWorkerActiveStatus(a.state));
124	
125	  return maxTimestamp(
126	    run.updatedAt,
127	    ...activeWorkers.map((w) => w.updatedAt),
128	    ...activeAgents.map((a) => a.updatedAt),
129	    run.createdAt,
130	  );
131	}
132	
133	export function isSidebarRunCurrentlyWorking(
134	  args: Pick<SidebarRunActivityArgs, "run" | "workers" | "agents">,
135	): boolean {
136	  const { run, workers, agents } = args;
137	
138	  // Terminal runs are never "working" — stale worker metadata loses.
139	  if (isTerminalRunStatus(run.status)) return false;
140	
141	  const normalizedStatus = normalizeRunStatus(run.status);
142	  if (normalizedStatus === "needs_recovery") return false;
143	
144	  if (normalizedStatus !== "running" && normalizedStatus !== "awaiting_user") return false;
145	
146	  const runWorkers = workers.filter((w) => w.runId === run.id);
147	
148	  if (runWorkers.some((w) => isWorkerActiveStatus(w.status))) return true;
149	
150	  const runWorkerIds = new Set(runWorkers.map((w) => w.id));
151	  if (agents.some((a) => runWorkerIds.has(a.name) && isWorkerActiveStatus(a.state))) return true;
152	
153	  // Run is "running" with no active workers/agents yet — still counts.
154	  return normalizedStatus === "running";
155	}

157	export interface RunActiveClassification {
158	  isActive: boolean;
159	  isUnread: boolean;
160	  isWorking: boolean;
161	  isRecent: boolean;
162	  recentActivityAt: string | null;
163	  activeSortAt: string | null;
164	}
165	
166	export function classifySidebarRun(args: SidebarRunActivityArgs): RunActiveClassification {
167	  const { run, readMarkers, nowMs } = args;
168	  const lastReadAt = readMarkers[run.id] ?? null;
169	  const normalizedStatus = normalizeRunStatus(run.status);
170	
171	  const latestUnreadAt = getRunLatestUnreadTimestamp(run, args.messages);
172	  const isUnread = isRunUnread({ latestMessageAt: latestUnreadAt, lastReadAt });
173	
174	  const isWorking = isSidebarRunCurrentlyWorking(args);
175	
176	  const recentActivityAt = getSidebarRunLastActivityAt(args);
177	  const allowsRecentActivity = normalizedStatus !== "cancelled" && normalizedStatus !== "canceled";
178	  const isRecent =
179	    allowsRecentActivity &&
180	    recentActivityAt !== null &&
181	    nowMs - parseTimestampMs(recentActivityAt) <= ACTIVE_SESSION_ACTIVITY_WINDOW_MS;
182	
183	  const isSelected = args.selectedRunId != null && args.run.id === args.selectedRunId;
184	  const isActive = isUnread || isWorking || isRecent || isSelected;
185	
186	  let activeSortAt: string | null = recentActivityAt;
187	  if (isUnread && latestUnreadAt) {
188	    activeSortAt = maxTimestamp(activeSortAt, latestUnreadAt);
189	  }
190	  if (isWorking) {
191	    activeSortAt = maxTimestamp(activeSortAt, getWorkingActivityAt(args));
192	  }
193	  if (!activeSortAt) activeSortAt = run.createdAt;
194	
195	  return { isActive, isUnread, isWorking, isRecent, recentActivityAt, activeSortAt };
196	}

198	export function compareActiveSidebarRunsDesc(
199	  a: { activeSortAt: string | null; createdAt: string; id: string },
200	  b: { activeSortAt: string | null; createdAt: string; id: string },
201	): number {
202	  const diff = parseTimestampMs(b.activeSortAt) - parseTimestampMs(a.activeSortAt);
203	  if (diff !== 0) return diff;
204	  const createdDiff = parseTimestampMs(b.createdAt) - parseTimestampMs(a.createdAt);
205	  if (createdDiff !== 0) return createdDiff;
206	  return a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0;
207	}
208	
209	export interface BuildActiveGroupsArgs {
210	  groups: SidebarGroup[];
211	  messages: MessageInput[];
212	  readMarkers: Record<string, string>;
213	  workers: WorkerInput[];
214	  agents: AgentInput[];
215	  queuedMessages: QueuedMessageInput[];
216	  workerOutputObservedAtByRunId: Record<string, string>;
217	  nowMs: number;
218	  selectedRunId?: string | null;
219	}
220	
221	export function buildActiveConversationGroups(args: BuildActiveGroupsArgs): SidebarGroup[] {
222	  const { groups, messages, readMarkers, workers, agents, queuedMessages, workerOutputObservedAtByRunId, nowMs, selectedRunId } = args;
223	
224	  const activeGroups: Array<{ group: SidebarGroup; latestActivityMs: number }> = [];
225	
226	  for (const group of groups) {
227	    const activeRuns: Array<SidebarRun & { activeSortAt: string | null }> = [];
228	    let groupLatestMs = 0;
229	
230	    for (const run of group.runs) {
231	      const result = classifySidebarRun({
232	        run: {
233	          id: run.id,
234	          status: run.status,
235	          createdAt: run.createdAt,
236	          updatedAt: (run as SidebarRun & { updatedAt?: string | null }).updatedAt ?? null,
237	        },
238	        messages,
239	        readMarkers,
240	        workers,
241	        agents,
242	        queuedMessages,
243	        workerOutputObservedAtByRunId,
244	        nowMs,
245	        selectedRunId,
246	      });
247	
248	      if (!result.isActive) continue;
249	
250	      activeRuns.push({ ...run, activeSortAt: result.activeSortAt });
251	      const ms = parseTimestampMs(result.activeSortAt);
252	      if (ms > groupLatestMs) groupLatestMs = ms;
253	    }
254	
255	    if (activeRuns.length === 0) continue;
256	
257	    activeRuns.sort(compareActiveSidebarRunsDesc);
258	
259	    activeGroups.push({
260	      group: { path: group.path, name: group.name, runs: activeRuns },
261	      latestActivityMs: groupLatestMs,
262	    });
263	  }
264	
265	  activeGroups.sort((a, b) => {
266	    const diff = b.latestActivityMs - a.latestActivityMs;
267	    if (diff !== 0) return diff;
268	    if (a.group.name < b.group.name) return -1;
269	    if (a.group.name > b.group.name) return 1;
270	    if (a.group.path < b.group.path) return -1;
271	    if (a.group.path > b.group.path) return 1;
272	    return 0;
273	  });
274	
275	  return activeGroups.map((entry) => entry.group);
276	}
277	
278	// Apply search to the active groups.
279	// If the query matches the project name, all active sessions in that project remain visible.
280	// Otherwise filter active sessions whose title or path matches the query.
281	export function filterActiveConversationGroups(
282	  activeGroups: SidebarGroup[],
283	  searchQuery: string,
284	): SidebarGroup[] {
285	  if (!searchQuery) return activeGroups;
286	  const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
287	
288	  return activeGroups
289	    .map((group) => {
290	      if (group.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
291	        // Project name matches — show all active sessions in this project.
292	        return group;
293	      }
294	      // Otherwise filter sessions by title or path.
295	      const runs = group.runs.filter(
296	        (run) => run.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || run.path.toLowerCase().includes(q),
297	      );
298	      return { ...group, runs };
299	    })
300	    .filter((group) => group.runs.length > 0);
301	}
