1	// Non-persistent live worker-output observation timestamps derived from
2	// worker-entry cursor increases. Only seq increases after the initial baseline
3	// are counted as recent activity; historical entries never make a run look active.
4	
5	export interface SidebarWorkerObservation {
6	  runId: string | null;
7	  seq: number;
8	  observedAt: string;
9	}
10	
11	export class SidebarWorkerActivityManager {
12	  // Baseline seqs from the initial snapshot; these are NOT counted as recent.
13	  private readonly baselineSeqs = new Map<string, number>();
14	  // Live observations: workerId -> { runId, seq, observedAt }
15	  private readonly observations = new Map<string, SidebarWorkerObservation>();
16	  // Derived view: runId -> latest observed worker-output timestamp
17	  private readonly runOutputAt = new Map<string, string>();
18	
19	  // Called with workerEntrySeqs from every snapshot/update to establish baselines.
20	  // Does NOT record an observation — only sets the floor for future seq comparisons.
21	  onKnownSeqs(seqs: Record<string, number> | undefined): void {
22	    if (!seqs) return;
23	    for (const [workerId, seq] of Object.entries(seqs)) {
24	      if (typeof seq !== "number") continue;
25	      // Set baseline only if we have not yet seen a live increase for this worker.
26	      if (!this.observations.has(workerId) && !this.baselineSeqs.has(workerId)) {
27	        this.baselineSeqs.set(workerId, seq);
28	      }
29	    }
30	  }
31	
32	  // Called when a worker.entry_appended SSE frame arrives.
33	  // Only records an observation when seq strictly exceeds the known baseline.
34	  onWakeUp(args: { workerId: string; seq: number; runId?: string | null }): void {
35	    const { workerId, seq, runId } = args;
36	    const baseline = this.baselineSeqs.get(workerId);
37	
38	    if (baseline === undefined) {
39	      // First time seeing this worker — treat this as the baseline.
40	      this.baselineSeqs.set(workerId, seq);
41	      return;
42	    }
43	
44	    if (seq <= baseline) {
45	      // Not a new entry after page load; ignore.
46	      return;
47	    }
48	
49	    const existing = this.observations.get(workerId);
50	    if (existing && existing.seq >= seq) {
51	      // No-op: already recorded this seq or a later one.
52	      return;
53	    }
54	
55	    const observedAt = new Date().toISOString();
56	    const resolvedRunId = runId ?? existing?.runId ?? null;
57	
58	    this.observations.set(workerId, { runId: resolvedRunId, seq, observedAt });
59	
60	    if (resolvedRunId) {
61	      const current = this.runOutputAt.get(resolvedRunId);
62	      if (!current || new Date(observedAt).getTime() > new Date(current).getTime()) {
63	        this.runOutputAt.set(resolvedRunId, observedAt);
64	      }
65	    }
66	  }
67	
68	  getRunOutputAt(runId: string): string | null {
69	    return this.runOutputAt.get(runId) ?? null;
70	  }
71	
72	  getRunOutputAtRecord(): Record<string, string> {
73	    return Object.fromEntries(this.runOutputAt);
74	  }
75	}

````text
1	# Frontend State and Rendering
2	
3	This document is the source of truth for state ownership, subscription boundaries, high-churn state policy, and render-performance budgets in the OmniHarness Next.js app shell.
4	
5	Related incident note:
6	`docs/architecture/state-staleness-and-session-lifecycle-lessons.md` records
7	the May 2026 conversation-loading regressions where cached selected-run state
8	was not hydrated immediately, unchanged snapshots were reapplied, fallback
9	`messages` rows rendered before worker entries were loaded, and scroll
10	affordances treated bottom padding as real content.
11	
12	## Manager Ownership
13	
14	Each shared manager owns a focused slice of UI state. Components should subscribe via `useManagerSelector` to a narrow slice; broad `useManagerSnapshot` reads are only permitted in approved leaf containers (see `tests/ui/react-best-practices.test.ts`).
15	
16	| Manager | Owned state | Notes |
17	| --- | --- | --- |
18	| `HomeUiStateManager` | shell UI: selected run id, composer worker/model/effort/mode selections, dialog visibility, sidebar widths, mobile nav, attachments, editing rename state, runtime errors, read markers, draft project path | Stores transient view state; do not put server data here |
19	| `EventStreamStateManager` | live event snapshot, cached output entries, merged runs/messages/workers/events | Persists per-run snapshots; merges live updates |
20	| `SettingsDraftManager` | unsaved settings draft and save payload | Hydrated once per successful settings load |
21	| `BusyMessageQueueManager` | queued message visibility, cancellation state | Updated optimistically by composer controller |
22	| `AppearancePreferencesManager` | text-size preferences, theme-adjacent UI prefs | Persists to localStorage |
23	| `SideWindowManager` | side-window open state, current resource | Opens in response to project file refs |
24	| Component-level managers (e.g. inside `Terminal`, `WorkerCard`) | local component UI state (expanded groups, scroll-follow, search) | Never lifted into `HomeUiStateManager` |
25	
26	## Conversation Loading Invariants
27	
28	- Selecting a run hydrates `EventStreamStateManager` from the scoped frontend
29	  cache immediately, then asks the server whether the snapshot checksum changed.
30	- A not-modified snapshot confirms freshness and must not replace local state.
31	- Worker-backed transcripts render from `WorkerEntriesManager` entries. Legacy
32	  `messages` rows are fallback evidence only after the selected worker stream
33	  is fully loaded.
34	- Conversation first-positioning and "more below" affordances must be driven by
35	  meaningful transcript overflow, not bottom padding or pending-state spacers.
36	
37	## High-Churn State Rules
38	
39	The following kinds of state must NOT cause `HomeApp` (the shell) to re-render:
40	
41	- Composer draft text, cursor position, mention search index.
42	- Hover / pointer / open flags for menus and tooltips.
43	- Per-keystroke search filters.
44	- Active resize / drag pointer position.
45	- Terminal scroll position, follow flag, and tool-group expansion.
46	
47	Rules:
48	
49	1. High-churn state lives in a leaf container's own `useState`, a dedicated manager, or behind a narrow `useManagerSelector`.
50	2. The root `HomeApp` may only subscribe to a small set of shell-level fields via `useManagerSelector` (selected run id, dialog visibility, mobile-nav state, sidebar widths).
51	3. No component above the composer subtree may subscribe to draft text.
52	4. No component above a worker card may subscribe to per-worker scroll state.
53	
54	## Subscription Boundary Policy
55	
56	- Default to `useManagerSelector(manager, (s) => slice)` with a tuple/object selector that returns stable identity where possible.
57	- Use the optional equality function for record/set selections.
58	- Shared `useSyncExternalStore` wrappers must return the manager's immutable
59	  initial state from `getServerSnapshot`. Never return browser-hydrated current
60	  state there: server and first client markup must match.
61	- Cache selector-derived server snapshots. Returning a fresh object from
62	  `getServerSnapshot` can cause hydration warnings or an infinite render loop.
63	- Read localStorage and other browser persistence only after mount, then notify
64	  subscribers so React performs a normal client update.
65	- Reserve `useManagerSnapshot(manager)` for:
66	  - the manager's owning container (where the entire state is needed for layout wiring).
67	  - tests and devtools.
68	- New code may not call `useManagerSnapshot(homeUiStateManager)` outside the explicit allowlist in `tests/ui/react-best-practices.test.ts`.
69	
70	## Snapshot Merge Safety
71	
72	Live event snapshots are not automatically authoritative. If a payload does
73	not declare a complete scope, it is a partial update and must not erase local
74	optimistic state, recently created sessions, delivered worker-stream inputs, or
75	read markers.
76	
77	State merge bugs are documented in
78	`docs/architecture/state-staleness-and-session-lifecycle-lessons.md`. Read that
79	note before changing `EventStreamStateManager`, `mergePendingCreatedConversationSnapshots`,
80	`WorkerEntriesManager`, queued-message UI state, or read-marker logic.
81	
82	## Render Performance Budgets
83	
84	For local development (Apple Silicon, Node 22, default `pnpm dev`):
85	
86	| Metric | Baseline (2026-05-11) | Budget |
87	| --- | --- | --- |
88	| Cold `/` compile + TTFB | ~12 s | ≤ 15 s |
89	| Cold `/api/auth/session` | ~12 s | ≤ 15 s |
90	| Warm `/` TTFB | ~1.39 s (pre-refactor) → 36 ms (post-refactor, server already warm) | ≤ 1.6 s |
91	| Warm `/api/auth/session` TTFB | ~0.86 s (pre-refactor) → 10 ms (post-refactor) | ≤ 1.0 s |
92	| `pnpm build` total | ~90 s | ≤ 110 s |
93	| `/` route size (build report) | 157 kB (pre-refactor) → 160 kB (post-refactor) | ≤ 165 kB |
94	| `/` first-load JS | 319 kB (pre-refactor) → 323 kB (post-refactor) | ≤ 330 kB |
95	
96	Post-refactor measurement taken 2026-05-11 (node v22.22.0, darwin arm64, dev server already warm):
97	
98	```
99	cold /                    200   964 ms
100	cold /api/auth/session    200  3785 ms
101	warm /                    200    36 ms
102	warm /api/auth/session    200    10 ms
103	```
104	
105	Run `pnpm exec node scripts/measure-local-dev.mjs` (see "Measurement" below) to capture comparable numbers.
106	
107	## Home Hooks
108	
109	`HomeApp.tsx` is the composition root. It wires:
110	
111	- `useHomeQueries` — auth session, settings, worker catalog, project files.
112	- `useHomeMutations` — login/logout/pair, save settings, run mutations.
113	- `useConversationActions` — rename / delete / archive / recover / fork / retry / commit / promote actions.
114	- `useHomeViewModel` — pure derivations (selected run, worker groups, timeline items, busy state, recovery, composer options).
115	- `useHomeLayoutController` — sidebar, mobile nav, side window, resize.
116	- `useComposerController` — composer draft selection, mention filtering, submit, attachments.
117	- `useHomeLifecycle` — route hydration, theme persistence, runtime error capture, pair-redeem flow.
118	- `useRunSelectionEffects` — worker hydration when selected run changes.
119	
120	`HomeApp.tsx` itself is responsible only for:
121	
122	- Auth gate rendering (login / boot shell / authenticated shell).
123	- Top-level layout composition.
124	- Wiring major child components (sidebar, header, conversation main, side window, composer).
125	- Mounting modal/dialog roots.
126	
127	Target: under 700 lines.
128	
129	## Measurement
130	
131	`scripts/measure-local-dev.mjs` measures cold/warm response times against a running dev server.
132	
133	```bash
134	# Make sure :3035 is free or a dev server is already running on it
135	lsof -nP -iTCP:3035 -sTCP:LISTEN
136	
137	# If not running:
138	pnpm dev &
139	DEV_PID=$!
140	
141	# Measure
142	pnpm exec node scripts/measure-local-dev.mjs
143	
144	# Clean up
145	kill $DEV_PID
146	```
147	
148	The script writes a timestamped row to stdout suitable for pasting into this doc when establishing a new baseline.
149

async function clearStaleDirectCurrentText(run: typeof runs.$inferSelect, worker: typeof workers.$inferSelect) {
  if (!isDirectRunMode(run.mode) || !isTerminalRunStatus(run.status) || !isIdleDirectWorkerWithStaleCurrentText(worker)) {
    return false;
  }

  await withSqliteBusyRetry(() => db.update(workers).set({
    currentText: "",
    lastText: worker.lastText || worker.currentText,
    updatedAt: new Date(),
  }).where(eq(workers.id, worker.id)));
  notifyEventStreamSubscribers();
  return true;
}

function workerCreatedAtMs(worker: typeof workers.$inferSelect) {
  const time = worker.createdAt.getTime();
  return Number.isFinite(time) ? time : 0;
}

function compareWorkersForFollowUp(a: typeof workers.$inferSelect, b: typeof workers.$inferSelect) {
  const workerNumberDiff = (b.workerNumber ?? 0) - (a.workerNumber ?? 0);
  if (workerNumberDiff !== 0) {
    return workerNumberDiff;
  }

  const createdAtDiff = workerCreatedAtMs(b) - workerCreatedAtMs(a);
  if (createdAtDiff !== 0) {
    return createdAtDiff;
    const staleImplementationConnectionFailure = isRecoverableImplementationConnectionFailure(run);
    if (run.mode === "implementation") {
      const implementationWorkers = allWorkers.filter((candidate) => candidate.runId === run.id);
      let syncedActiveLiveWorker = false;

      for (const implementationWorker of implementationWorkers) {
        const implementationAgent = agents.find((candidate) => candidate.name === implementationWorker.id);
        const cancelledWorkerHasMatchingLiveSession = Boolean(
          implementationAgent
          && implementationWorker.bridgeSessionId
          && implementationWorker.bridgeSessionMode
          && implementationAgent.sessionId === implementationWorker.bridgeSessionId
          && implementationAgent.sessionMode === implementationWorker.bridgeSessionMode,
        );
        if (isCancelledWorkerStatus(implementationWorker.status)
          && !cancelledWorkerHasMatchingLiveSession) {
          continue;
        }
        if (!implementationAgent || !isCleanLiveAgent(implementationAgent) || !isActiveLiveAgent(implementationAgent)) {
          continue;
        }

        await writeWorkerOutputEntries(run.id, implementationWorker.id, implementationAgent.outputEntries);
        await withSqliteBusyRetry(() => db.update(workers).set({
          status: implementationAgent.state,
          cwd: implementationAgent.cwd || implementationWorker.cwd,
          currentText: implementationAgent.currentText,
          lastText: implementationAgent.lastText,
          bridgeSessionId: implementationAgent.sessionId ?? implementationWorker.bridgeSessionId,
          bridgeSessionMode: implementationAgent.sessionMode ?? implementationWorker.bridgeSessionMode,

416	  const blocks: React.ReactNode[] = [];
417	  let index = 0;

1	type LiveUpdateListener = () => void;
2	type EventStreamWaitResult = {
3	  notified: boolean;
4	};
5	
6	const listeners = new Set<LiveUpdateListener>();
7	let notificationVersion = 0;
8	
9	export function notifyEventStreamSubscribers() {
10	  notificationVersion += 1;
11	  for (const listener of listeners) {
12	    listener();
13	  }
14	}
15	
16	export function getEventStreamNotificationVersion() {
17	  return notificationVersion;
18	}

20	export function waitForEventStreamNotification(timeoutMs: number, afterVersion = notificationVersion) {
21	  return new Promise<EventStreamWaitResult>((resolve) => {
22	    if (notificationVersion > afterVersion) {
23	      resolve({ notified: true });
24	      return;
25	    }
26	
27	    let settled = false;
28	    let timeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
29	
30	    const cleanup = (result: EventStreamWaitResult) => {
31	      if (settled) {
32	        return;
33	      }
34	
35	      settled = true;
36	      if (timeout) {
37	        clearTimeout(timeout);
38	      }
39	      listeners.delete(listener);
40	      resolve(result);
41	    };
42	
43	    const listener = () => cleanup({ notified: true });
44	    listeners.add(listener);
45	    timeout = setTimeout(() => cleanup({ notified: false }), timeoutMs);
46	  });
47	}

1	export function getRunLatestMessageTimestamp(
2	  runId: string,
3	  messages: Array<{ runId: string; createdAt: string }>
4	) {
5	  let latest: string | null = null;
6	
7	  for (const message of messages) {
8	    if (message.runId !== runId) {
9	      continue;
10	    }
11	
12	    if (!latest || new Date(message.createdAt).getTime() > new Date(latest).getTime()) {
13	      latest = message.createdAt;
14	    }
15	  }
16	
17	  return latest;
18	}
19	
20	function timestampMs(value: string | null | undefined) {
21	  if (!value) {
22	    return 0;
23	  }
24	
25	  const time = new Date(value).getTime();
26	  return Number.isFinite(time) ? time : 0;
27	}
28	
29	function laterTimestamp(left: string | null, right: string | null | undefined) {
30	  if (!right) {
31	    return left;
32	  }
33	
34	  if (!left || timestampMs(right) > timestampMs(left)) {
35	    return right;
36	  }
37	
38	  return left;
39	}
40	
41	export function getRunLatestUnreadTimestamp(
42	  run: { id: string; status?: string | null; updatedAt?: string | null; createdAt?: string | null },
43	  messages: Array<{ runId: string; createdAt: string }>
44	) {
45	  const latestMessageAt = getRunLatestMessageTimestamp(run.id, messages);
46	  const status = run.status?.trim().toLowerCase().split(":")[0]?.trim() ?? "";
47	
48	  if (status === "done" || status === "awaiting_user" || status === "failed" || status === "needs_recovery") {
49	    return laterTimestamp(latestMessageAt, run.updatedAt ?? run.createdAt ?? null);
50	  }
51	
52	  return latestMessageAt;
53	}
54	
55	export function isRunUnread(args: {
56	  latestMessageAt: string | null;
57	  lastReadAt: string | null;
58	}) {
59	  if (!args.latestMessageAt) {
60	    return false;
61	  }
62	
63	  if (!args.lastReadAt) {
64	    return true;
65	  }
66	
67	  return new Date(args.latestMessageAt).getTime() > new Date(args.lastReadAt).getTime();
68	}

1	/**
2	 * Single source of truth for the unified worker conversation stream on
3	 * the frontend.
4	 *
5	 * Per (workerId) we hold a contiguous *window* [lowestSeq..latestContiguousSeq]:
6	 *   - entries: the contiguous window in seq order, never with gaps.
7	 *   - lowestSeq: the lowest seq currently in `entries` (0 if empty).
8	 *   - latestContiguousSeq: the highest seq we have proven contiguous
9	 *     from lowestSeq. Used as the cursor for forward refetch.
10	 *   - latestKnownSeq: the highest seq the server has told us exists.
11	 *     Updates immediately on a wake-up frame; the fetch fills the gap.
12	 *   - hasOlder: true if older entries exist on the server before
13	 *     lowestSeq. Set by initial tail-load and `loadOlder`.
14	 *   - status: "idle" → "loading" → "loaded"; "error" on a fetch failure.
15	 *
16	 * Initial load fetches the last N entries via `?limit=N`. Forward
17	 * extension uses `?afterSeq=latestContiguousSeq`. Backward hydration
18	 * uses `?beforeSeq=lowestSeq&limit=N` via `loadOlder`.
19	 *
20	 * SSE frames carry only `{ workerId, seq }` — the content is fetched
21	 * via the HTTP endpoint. The frame is a wake-up hint; we never trust
22	 * it as the entry payload.
23	 */
24	import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
25	import type { WorkerEntry } from "@/shared/worker-entries";
26	import type { RuntimeAPIs } from "@/runtime-api/types";
27	import { useRuntimeAPIs } from "@/runtime-api/provider";
28	
29	/**
30	 * Collapse multiple rows that share an entry `id` into a single
31	 * conversation item. The server's unified stream intentionally appends
32	 * a new row whenever an entry's text grows (so a streaming assistant
33	 * message can be revised in place — see the
34	 * `appends changed bridge message revisions so streaming prose can expand`
35	 * test in `tests/server/workers/output-store.test.ts`). It also
36	 * writes the same user_input id onto a newer worker's stream when a run
37	 * cycles through workers.
38	 *
39	 * Coalesce policy:
40	 *   - Keep the entry at its FIRST appearance in the input order, so
41	 *     conversational position doesn't jump when text grows.
42	 *   - Use the LATEST revision's text / metadata (text grows; latest
43	 *     revision is the finished one).
44	 *   - Take the timestamp from the copy on the NEWEST worker, because that
45	 *     is the one the live thread actually contains. Neither "earliest" nor
46	 *     "latest" works on its own: a rewind re-delivers a message with a new
47	 *     timestamp (newest is right, earliest pins it back above output it was
48	 *     rewound past), while `reconcileWorkerUserMessagesInStream` backfills
49	 *     history onto a fresh worker with the original `createdAt` (earliest is
50	 *     right, latest drags the opening prompt into the middle of the day).
51	 *     Worker order settles both. Copies from the same worker — streaming
52	 *     revisions, which share a timestamp anyway — keep the earliest.
53	 *   - Entries without an id pass through unchanged.
54	 *
55	 * `workerOrder` is the run's workers in creation order. Without it (a single
56	 * worker stream, or a caller that has no worker list yet) the earliest
57	 * timestamp is kept, which is the conservative choice: a message stays where
58	 * it already is.
59	 */
60	export function coalesceWorkerEntriesById(
61	  entries: ReadonlyArray<WorkerEntry>,
62	  workerOrder: ReadonlyArray<string> = [],
63	): WorkerEntry[] {
64	  const workerRank = new Map(workerOrder.map((workerId, index) => [workerId, index]));
65	  const rankOf = (entry: WorkerEntry) => {
66	    const workerId = (entry as { workerId?: unknown }).workerId;
67	    return typeof workerId === "string" ? workerRank.get(workerId) ?? -1 : -1;
68	  };
69	
70	  const positionByKey = new Map<string, number>();
71	  const placementByKey = new Map<string, { timestamp: string; rank: number }>();
72	  const result: WorkerEntry[] = [];
73	  for (const entry of entries) {
74	    const key = typeof entry.id === "string" && entry.id ? entry.id : null;
75	    if (!key) {
76	      result.push(entry);
77	      continue;
78	    }
79	    const existingPosition = positionByKey.get(key);
80	    if (existingPosition === undefined) {
81	      positionByKey.set(key, result.length);
82	      if (entry.timestamp) {
83	        placementByKey.set(key, { timestamp: entry.timestamp, rank: rankOf(entry) });
84	      }
85	      result.push(entry);
86	    } else {
87	      const held = placementByKey.get(key);
88	      const candidate = entry.timestamp;
89	      const candidateRank = rankOf(entry);
90	      let preservedTimestamp = candidate;
91	      if (held && candidate) {
92	        // Smaller ISO string compares as earlier datetime for the same
93	        // timezone offset — all our timestamps are emitted with a `Z` suffix,
94	        // so string compare matches Date compare.
95	        const keepCandidate = candidateRank > held.rank
96	          || (candidateRank === held.rank && candidate < held.timestamp);
97	        preservedTimestamp = keepCandidate ? candidate : held.timestamp;
98	        placementByKey.set(key, {
99	          timestamp: preservedTimestamp,
100	          rank: Math.max(candidateRank, held.rank),
101	        });
102	      } else if (held) {
103	        preservedTimestamp = held.timestamp;
104	      } else if (candidate) {
105	        placementByKey.set(key, { timestamp: candidate, rank: candidateRank });
106	      }
107	      result[existingPosition] = { ...entry, timestamp: preservedTimestamp };
108	    }
109	  }
110	  return result;
111	}
112	
113	type WorkerEntryStorage = Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "setItem" | "removeItem">;
114	
115	// v2: transcript recovery renumbered seqs and changed entry ids on repaired
116	// worker streams. This cache merges with server data by entry id, so a v1
117	// cache keeps rendering stale pre-repair entries (raw streaming fragments)
118	// alongside the fixed ones — a transcript shredded mid-word. Bumping the key
119	// retires those caches instead of requiring users to clear storage by hand.
120	const DEFAULT_STORAGE_KEY = "omni-worker-entries-cache:v2";
121	const DEFAULT_MAX_WORKERS = 16;
122	const DEFAULT_MAX_SERIALIZED_BYTES = 4_000_000;
123	const DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT = 100;
124	const DEFAULT_OLDER_LIMIT = 100;
125	// Entries are remembered on every append and every stream poll. Serializing
126	// the whole cache envelope synchronously on each one is main-thread work that
127	// competes with keystrokes, so the write is coalesced onto a trailing timer
128	// while reads stay served from the in-memory envelope.
129	const DEFAULT_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS = 1_000;
130	
131	interface CachedWorkerStream {
132	  updatedAt: number;
133	  entries: WorkerEntry[];
134	}
135	
136	interface WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope {
137	  version: 1;
138	  workers: Record<string, CachedWorkerStream>;
139	}
140	
141	export type WorkerStreamStatus = "idle" | "loading" | "loaded" | "error";
142	
143	export interface WorkerStreamState {
144	  workerId: string;
145	  entries: WorkerEntry[];
146	  lowestSeq: number;
147	  latestContiguousSeq: number;
148	  latestKnownSeq: number;
149	  hasOlder: boolean;
150	  status: WorkerStreamStatus;
151	  lastError: string | null;
152	  needsTailValidation?: boolean;
153	}
154	
155	type Listener = (state: WorkerStreamState) => void;
156	
157	interface FetchResponse {
158	  entries: WorkerEntry[];
159	  latestSeq: number;
160	  hasOlder?: boolean;
161	}
162	
163	export interface WorkerEntriesManagerOptions {
164	  listEntries?: RuntimeAPIs["workers"]["listEntries"];
165	  storage?: WorkerEntryStorage | null;
166	  storageKey?: string;
167	  maxWorkers?: number;
168	  maxSerializedBytes?: number;
169	  now?: () => number;
170	  flushIntervalMs?: number;
171	}
172	
173	function latestSeq(entries: WorkerEntry[]) {
174	  return entries.reduce((latest, entry) => (
175	    typeof entry.seq === "number" && Number.isFinite(entry.seq)
176	      ? Math.max(latest, entry.seq)
177	      : latest
178	  ), 0);
179	}
180	
181	function initialState(
182	  workerId: string,
183	  entries: WorkerEntry[] = [],
184	  options: { needsTailValidation?: boolean } = {},
185	): WorkerStreamState {
186	  const latest = latestSeq(entries);
187	  const lowest = entries.length > 0
188	    ? entries.reduce((acc, entry) => (
189	      typeof entry.seq === "number" && entry.seq > 0 && (acc === 0 || entry.seq < acc) ? entry.seq : acc
190	    ), 0)
191	    : 0;
192	  return {
193	    workerId,
194	    entries,
195	    lowestSeq: lowest,
196	    latestContiguousSeq: latest,
197	    latestKnownSeq: latest,
198	    hasOlder: lowest > 1,
199	    status: entries.length > 0 ? "loaded" : "idle",
200	    lastError: null,
201	    needsTailValidation: options.needsTailValidation,
202	  };
203	}
204	
205	function defaultStorage(): WorkerEntryStorage | null {
206	  if (typeof window === "undefined" || typeof window.localStorage === "undefined") {
207	    return null;
208	  }
209	  return window.localStorage;
210	}
211	
212	function emptyEnvelope(): WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope {
213	  return {
214	    version: 1,
215	    workers: {},
216	  };
217	}
218	
219	function isWorkerEntryArray(value: unknown): value is WorkerEntry[] {
220	  return Array.isArray(value) && value.every((entry) => (
221	    typeof entry === "object"
222	    && entry !== null
223	    && typeof (entry as Partial<WorkerEntry>).id === "string"
224	    && typeof (entry as Partial<WorkerEntry>).seq === "number"
225	  ));
226	}
227	
228	function compactEntryForCache(entry: WorkerEntry): WorkerEntry {
229	  return {
230	    ...entry,
231	    raw: undefined,
232	  };
233	}
234	
235	export const EMPTY_WORKER_STREAM_STATE: WorkerStreamState = initialState("__none__");
236	
237	export class WorkerEntriesManager {
238	  private readonly stateByWorker = new Map<string, WorkerStreamState>();
239	  private readonly listenersByWorker = new Map<string, Set<Listener>>();
240	  private readonly inFlightByWorker = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
241	  private readonly wakeVersionByWorker = new Map<string, number>();
242	  private readonly everLoadedWorkers = new Set<string>();
243	  private listEntries: RuntimeAPIs["workers"]["listEntries"] | null;
244	  private readonly storage: WorkerEntryStorage | null;
245	  private readonly storageKey: string;
246	  private readonly maxWorkers: number;
247	  private readonly maxSerializedBytes: number;
248	  private readonly now: () => number;
249	  private readonly flushIntervalMs: number;
250	  private envelope: WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope | null = null;
251	  private flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
252	
253	  constructor(options: WorkerEntriesManagerOptions = {}) {
254	    const usesDefaultStorage = options.storage === undefined;
255	    this.listEntries = options.listEntries ?? null;
256	    this.storage = usesDefaultStorage ? defaultStorage() : options.storage ?? null;
257	    this.storageKey = options.storageKey ?? DEFAULT_STORAGE_KEY;
258	    this.maxWorkers = options.maxWorkers ?? DEFAULT_MAX_WORKERS;
259	    this.maxSerializedBytes = options.maxSerializedBytes ?? DEFAULT_MAX_SERIALIZED_BYTES;
260	    this.now = options.now ?? Date.now;
261	    this.flushIntervalMs = options.flushIntervalMs ?? DEFAULT_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS;
262	
263	    if (usesDefaultStorage && this.storage && typeof window !== "undefined") {
264	      const flushNow = () => this.flushCache();
265	      window.addEventListener("pagehide", flushNow);
266	      window.addEventListener("visibilitychange", flushNow);
267	    }
268	  }
269	
270	  configure(listEntries: RuntimeAPIs["workers"]["listEntries"]) {
271	    this.listEntries = listEntries;
272	  }
273	
274	  private load(input: Parameters<RuntimeAPIs["workers"]["listEntries"]>[0]) {
275	    if (!this.listEntries) {
276	      return Promise.reject(new Error("Worker entries are not connected to the runtime."));
277	    }
278	    return this.listEntries(input) as Promise<FetchResponse>;
279	  }
280	
281	  getState(workerId: string, initialEntries: WorkerEntry[] = []): WorkerStreamState {
282	    const existing = this.stateByWorker.get(workerId);
283	    if (existing) {
284	      if (
285	        initialEntries.length > 0
286	        && existing.latestContiguousSeq === 0
287	        && existing.entries.length === 0
288	      ) {
289	        const hydrated = initialState(workerId, initialEntries);
290	        this.stateByWorker.set(workerId, hydrated);
291	        return hydrated;
292	      }
293	      return existing;
294	    }
295	    const cachedEntries = initialEntries.length > 0 ? [] : this.getCachedEntries(workerId);
296	    const rawNextEntries = initialEntries.length > 0 ? initialEntries : cachedEntries;
297	    // Trim to the tail window — see getCachedEntries for the rationale.
298	    // Same trim is applied to caller-supplied initialEntries (e.g. an
299	    // event-snapshot hydration) so a long transcript doesn't render in
300	    // full on mount.
301	    const nextEntries = rawNextEntries.length > DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT
302	      ? rawNextEntries.slice(-DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT)
303	      : rawNextEntries;
304	    const next = initialState(workerId, nextEntries, {
305	      needsTailValidation: initialEntries.length === 0 && cachedEntries.length > 0,
306	    });
307	    this.stateByWorker.set(workerId, next);
308	    if (nextEntries.length > 0) {
309	      this.rememberState(workerId, nextEntries);
310	    }
311	    return next;
312	  }
313	
314	  isLoaded(workerId: string): boolean {
315	    const state = this.stateByWorker.get(workerId);
316	    if (!state) {
317	      return false;
318	    }
319	    return (
320	      state.status === "loaded"
321	      && state.latestContiguousSeq === state.latestKnownSeq
322	      && !state.needsTailValidation
323	    );
324	  }
325	
326	  /**
327	   * Latched variant of `isLoaded`: once a worker's stream has completed a
328	   * validated load, this stays true through wake-up catch-up fetches and
329	   * refresh cycles. `isLoaded` flips false on every appended entry until the
330	   * gap is fetched, which makes it unusable as a render gate — anything
331	   * conditioned on it flickers while the worker streams output.
332	   */
333	  hasEverLoaded(workerId: string): boolean {
334	    if (this.everLoadedWorkers.has(workerId)) {
335	      return true;
336	    }
337	    const state = this.stateByWorker.get(workerId);
338	    if (state && state.status === "loaded" && !state.needsTailValidation) {
339	      this.everLoadedWorkers.add(workerId);
340	      return true;
341	    }
342	    return false;
343	  }
344	
345	  subscribe(workerId: string, listener: Listener): () => void {
346	    let bucket = this.listenersByWorker.get(workerId);
347	    if (!bucket) {
348	      bucket = new Set<Listener>();
349	      this.listenersByWorker.set(workerId, bucket);
350	    }
351	    bucket.add(listener);
352	    return () => {
353	      bucket?.delete(listener);
354	      if (bucket && bucket.size === 0) {
355	        this.listenersByWorker.delete(workerId);
356	      }
357	    };
358	  }
359	
360	  ensureLoaded(workerId: string): Promise<void> {
361	    const state = this.getState(workerId);
362	    if (state.status === "loading") {
363	      return this.inFlightByWorker.get(workerId) ?? Promise.resolve();
364	    }
365	    const loadedEmptyWithoutProof = state.status === "loaded"
366	      && state.latestContiguousSeq === 0
367	      && state.latestKnownSeq === 0
368	      && state.entries.length === 0;
369	    if (
370	      state.status === "loaded"
371	      && state.latestContiguousSeq === state.latestKnownSeq
372	      && !loadedEmptyWithoutProof
373	      && !state.needsTailValidation
374	    ) {
375	      return Promise.resolve();
376	    }
377	    // Cold start (no entries yet) → tail-load the last N entries instead
378	    // of pulling the whole transcript from seq 1.
379	    if (state.entries.length === 0 || state.needsTailValidation) {
380	      return this.fetchTail(workerId, DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT);
381	    }
382	    return this.fetchForward(workerId, state.latestContiguousSeq);
383	  }
384	
385	  /**
386	   * Fetch a page of older entries (strictly before lowestSeq). The
387	   * returned page is prepended to the window. Caller can poll
388	   * `state.hasOlder` to decide whether to keep loading on scroll-back.
389	   */
390	  loadOlder(workerId: string, limit: number = DEFAULT_OLDER_LIMIT): Promise<void> {
391	    const existing = this.inFlightByWorker.get(workerId);
392	    if (existing) return existing;
393	    const state = this.getState(workerId);
394	    if (!state.hasOlder || state.lowestSeq <= 1) {
395	      return Promise.resolve();
396	    }
397	    return this.fetchBefore(workerId, state.lowestSeq, limit);
398	  }
399	
400	  refresh(workerId: string): Promise<void> {
401	    const state = this.getState(workerId);
402	    return this.fetchForward(workerId, state.latestContiguousSeq);
403	  }
404	
405	  /**
406	   * Wake-up hint from the SSE stream. The body carries only
407	   * `{ workerId, seq }`; the entry payload is never trusted from here.
408	   * Triggers a refetch from the current contiguous cursor.
409	   */
410	  onWakeUp(args: { workerId: string; seq: number }): void {
411	    const state = this.getState(args.workerId);
412	    if (args.seq <= state.latestContiguousSeq) {
413	      // Already received; the wake-up was redundant (e.g. another tab fired).
414	      return;
415	    }
416	    this.updateState(args.workerId, {
417	      ...state,
418	      latestKnownSeq: Math.max(state.latestKnownSeq, args.seq),
419	    });
420	    this.markWake(args.workerId);
421	    void this.fetchForward(args.workerId, state.latestContiguousSeq);
422	  }
423	
424	  /**
425	   * Durable cursor hints from global event snapshots. These recover
426	   * from missed `worker.entry_appended` wake-up frames without carrying
427	   * worker transcript content on the global snapshot stream.
428	   */
429	  onKnownSeqs(workerEntrySeqs: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): void {
430	    if (!workerEntrySeqs) {
431	      return;
432	    }
433	
434	    for (const [workerId, rawSeq] of Object.entries(workerEntrySeqs)) {
435	      const seq = typeof rawSeq === "number" && Number.isFinite(rawSeq)
436	        ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(rawSeq))
437	        : 0;
438	      if (seq <= 0) {
439	        continue;
440	      }
441	
442	      const state = this.getState(workerId);
443	
444	      const latestKnownSeq = Math.max(state.latestKnownSeq, seq);
445	      if (latestKnownSeq <= state.latestContiguousSeq && state.status !== "error") {
446	        continue;
447	      }
448	
449	      this.updateState(workerId, {
450	        ...state,
451	        latestKnownSeq,
452	      });
453	      this.markWake(workerId);
454	      void this.fetchForward(workerId, state.latestContiguousSeq);
455	    }
456	  }
457	
458	  /**
459	   * Global SSE resync signal. Re-validates every worker we track by
460	   * refetching from each one's current contiguous cursor. A worker
461	   * whose `latestContiguousSeq === latestKnownSeq` will get an empty
462	   * fetch and stay loaded — a global resync is a no-op for it.
463	   */
464	  onStreamResync(): void {
465	    for (const workerId of this.stateByWorker.keys()) {
466	      const state = this.getState(workerId);
467	      void this.fetchForward(workerId, state.latestContiguousSeq);
468	    }
469	  }
470	
471	  reset(): void {
472	    this.stateByWorker.clear();
473	    this.listenersByWorker.clear();
474	    this.inFlightByWorker.clear();
475	    this.wakeVersionByWorker.clear();
476	    this.everLoadedWorkers.clear();
477	    if (this.flushTimer !== null) {
478	      clearTimeout(this.flushTimer);
479	      this.flushTimer = null;
480	    }
481	    this.envelope = null;
482	  }
483	
484	  private markWake(workerId: string): void {
485	    this.wakeVersionByWorker.set(workerId, (this.wakeVersionByWorker.get(workerId) ?? 0) + 1);
486	  }
487	
488	  private fetchTail(workerId: string, limit: number): Promise<void> {
489	    const existing = this.inFlightByWorker.get(workerId);
490	    if (existing) return existing;
491	    const previous = this.getState(workerId);
492	    this.updateState(workerId, { ...previous, status: "loading", lastError: null });
493	    const promise = this.load({ workerId, limit }).then(
494	      (response) => {
495	        const current = this.getState(workerId);
496	        const sorted = [...response.entries].sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
497	        const latestContiguous = sorted.length > 0 ? sorted[sorted.length - 1]!.seq : 0;
498	        const lowest = sorted.length > 0 ? sorted[0]!.seq : 0;
499	        // Preserve any latestKnownSeq advance that landed via wake-up
500	        // while this tail load was in flight.
501	        const currentKnown = current.needsTailValidation ? 0 : current.latestKnownSeq;
502	        const latestKnown = Math.max(currentKnown, response.latestSeq ?? 0, latestContiguous);
503	        this.updateState(workerId, {
504	          ...current,
505	          entries: sorted,
506	          lowestSeq: lowest,
507	          latestContiguousSeq: latestContiguous,
508	          latestKnownSeq: latestKnown,
509	          hasOlder: response.hasOlder ?? (lowest > 1),
510	          status: "loaded",
511	          lastError: null,
512	          needsTailValidation: false,
513	        });
514	      },
515	      (error: unknown) => {
516	        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
517	        const failing = this.getState(workerId);
518	        this.updateState(workerId, { ...failing, status: "error", lastError: message });
519	      },
520	    ).finally(() => {
521	      this.inFlightByWorker.delete(workerId);
522	      // If the server reported newer entries than we got in the tail
523	      // window, chase forward from latestContiguousSeq.
524	      const after = this.getState(workerId);
525	      if (after.status === "loaded" && after.latestContiguousSeq < after.latestKnownSeq) {
526	        void this.fetchForward(workerId, after.latestContiguousSeq);
527	      }
528	    });
529	    this.inFlightByWorker.set(workerId, promise);
530	    return promise;
531	  }
532	
533	  private fetchBefore(workerId: string, beforeSeq: number, limit: number): Promise<void> {
534	    const existing = this.inFlightByWorker.get(workerId);
535	    if (existing) return existing;
536	    const previous = this.getState(workerId);
537	    this.updateState(workerId, { ...previous, status: "loading", lastError: null });
538	    const promise = this.load({ workerId, beforeSeq, limit }).then(
539	      (response) => {
540	        const current = this.getState(workerId);
541	        // Only accept entries strictly older than our current window and
542	        // adjacent to it (no gap to lowestSeq). If we'd introduce a gap,
543	        // drop the page — `loadOlder` can be retried.
544	        const sorted = [...response.entries]
545	          .filter((entry) => typeof entry.seq === "number" && entry.seq > 0 && entry.seq < current.lowestSeq)
546	          .sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
547	        if (sorted.length === 0) {
548	          this.updateState(workerId, {
549	            ...current,
550	            hasOlder: response.hasOlder ?? false,
551	            status: "loaded",
552	            lastError: null,
553	          });
554	          return;
555	        }
556	        const highestOlderSeq = sorted[sorted.length - 1]!.seq;
557	        if (current.lowestSeq > 0 && highestOlderSeq !== current.lowestSeq - 1) {
558	          // Gap — older page doesn't butt up to our window. Don't merge
559	          // (would violate the contiguity invariant). Still advance the
560	          // hasOlder hint if the server thinks there's nothing left.
561	          this.updateState(workerId, {
562	            ...current,
563	            hasOlder: response.hasOlder ?? current.hasOlder,
564	            status: "loaded",
565	            lastError: null,
566	          });
567	          return;
568	        }
569	        const lowest = sorted[0]!.seq;
570	        const merged = [...sorted, ...current.entries];
571	        this.updateState(workerId, {
572	          ...current,
573	          entries: merged,
574	          lowestSeq: lowest,
575	          hasOlder: response.hasOlder ?? (lowest > 1),
576	          status: "loaded",
577	          lastError: null,
578	        });
579	      },
580	      (error: unknown) => {
581	        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
582	        const failing = this.getState(workerId);
583	        this.updateState(workerId, { ...failing, status: "error", lastError: message });
584	      },
585	    ).finally(() => {
586	      this.inFlightByWorker.delete(workerId);
587	    });
588	    this.inFlightByWorker.set(workerId, promise);
589	    return promise;
590	  }
591	
592	  private fetchForward(workerId: string, afterSeq: number): Promise<void> {
593	    const existing = this.inFlightByWorker.get(workerId);
594	    if (existing) {
595	      return existing;
596	    }
597	    const previous = this.getState(workerId);
598	    this.updateState(workerId, { ...previous, status: "loading", lastError: null });
599	    const cursorBeforeFetch = previous.latestContiguousSeq;
600	    const knownBeforeFetch = previous.latestKnownSeq;
601	    const wakeVersionBeforeFetch = this.wakeVersionByWorker.get(workerId) ?? 0;
602	    const promise = this.load({ workerId, afterSeq }).then(
603	      (response) => {
604	        this.applyFetchResult(workerId, afterSeq, response);
605	      },
606	      (error: unknown) => {
607	        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
608	        const failing = this.getState(workerId);
609	        this.updateState(workerId, { ...failing, status: "error", lastError: message });
610	      },
611	    ).finally(() => {
612	      this.inFlightByWorker.delete(workerId);
613	      // If applyFetchResult advanced the contiguous prefix and a known
614	      // gap remains, chase it now. Requiring progress prevents an
615	      // infinite loop when the server reports `latestSeq` ahead of the
616	      // entries it returned (race or stale latest hint).
617	      const after = this.getState(workerId);
618	      const wakeUpAdvancedKnownSeq = after.latestKnownSeq > knownBeforeFetch;
619	      const wakeUpArrivedDuringFetch = (this.wakeVersionByWorker.get(workerId) ?? 0) > wakeVersionBeforeFetch;
620	      if (
621	        after.status === "loaded"
622	        && (after.latestContiguousSeq > cursorBeforeFetch || wakeUpAdvancedKnownSeq || wakeUpArrivedDuringFetch)
623	        && after.latestContiguousSeq < after.latestKnownSeq
624	      ) {
625	        void this.fetchForward(workerId, after.latestContiguousSeq);
626	      }
627	    });
628	    this.inFlightByWorker.set(workerId, promise);
629	    return promise;
630	  }
631	
632	  private applyFetchResult(
633	    workerId: string,
634	    cursorBeforeFetch: number,
635	    response: FetchResponse,
636	  ): void {
637	    const previous = this.getState(workerId);
638	    // The endpoint returns entries strictly newer than `afterSeq`. If
639	    // the caller's view advanced between request and response, drop
640	    // anything we've already merged.
641	    const incoming = response.entries
642	      .filter((entry) => entry.seq > previous.latestContiguousSeq)
643	      .sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
644	
645	    let nextContiguous = previous.latestContiguousSeq;
646	    const merged = [...previous.entries];
647	    for (const entry of incoming) {
648	      if (entry.seq === nextContiguous + 1) {
649	        merged.push(entry);
650	        nextContiguous = entry.seq;
651	      } else if (entry.seq > nextContiguous + 1) {
652	        // Gap. Don't include the entry; the next forward load (kicked off
653	        // below) will cover both this seq and the missing ones.
654	        break;
655	      }
656	    }
657	
658	    const nextKnown = Math.max(previous.latestKnownSeq, response.latestSeq, nextContiguous);
659	    // If we started with no entries, lowestSeq becomes the first merged
660	    // entry's seq; otherwise the window's lower bound is unchanged.
661	    const nextLowest = previous.lowestSeq > 0
662	      ? previous.lowestSeq
663	      : merged[0]?.seq ?? 0;
664	    const next: WorkerStreamState = {
665	      ...previous,
666	      // Reuse the previous array when the poll appended nothing. The spread
667	      // above always allocates, so an idle validation poll used to hand every
668	      // subscriber a brand-new `entries` identity and invalidate each memo
669	      // derived from it — the transcript merge and Terminal's activity
670	      // rebuild both re-ran for a byte-identical result.
671	      entries: merged.length > previous.entries.length ? merged : previous.entries,
672	      lowestSeq: nextLowest,
673	      latestContiguousSeq: nextContiguous,
674	      latestKnownSeq: nextKnown,
675	      // hasOlder is preserved; only tail-load or loadOlder updates it.
676	      // A forward fetch starting from lowestSeq=0 (empty window) can't
677	      // assert anything about whether older entries exist.
678	      status: "loaded",
679	      lastError: null,
680	      needsTailValidation: false,
681	    };
682	    this.updateState(workerId, next);
683	
684	    // Gap chasing happens in the fetch wrapper's .finally so that
685	    // inFlightByWorker is cleared before the recursive call.
686	  }
687	
688	  private updateState(workerId: string, next: WorkerStreamState): void {
689	    this.stateByWorker.set(workerId, next);
690	    if (next.status === "loaded" && !next.needsTailValidation) {
691	      this.everLoadedWorkers.add(workerId);
692	    }
693	    if (next.status === "loaded") {
694	      this.rememberState(workerId, next.entries);
695	    }
696	    const listeners = this.listenersByWorker.get(workerId);
697	    if (!listeners) {
698	      return;
699	    }
700	    for (const listener of listeners) {
701	      listener(next);
702	    }
703	  }
704	
705	  private getCachedEntries(workerId: string): WorkerEntry[] {
706	    const cached = this.readEnvelope().workers[workerId];
707	    if (!cached || !isWorkerEntryArray(cached.entries)) {
708	      return [];
709	    }
710	    // Trim to the tail window. The cache used to rehydrate full
711	    // transcripts which caused the worker view to render every entry
712	    // from seq 1 and then auto-scroll down — bad UX on long sessions.
713	    // We want the user to see the most recent N entries immediately,
714	    // then load older ones on scroll-back via loadOlder().
715	    if (cached.entries.length > DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT) {
716	      return cached.entries.slice(-DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT);
717	    }
718	    return cached.entries;
719	  }
720	
721	  private rememberState(workerId: string, entries: WorkerEntry[]): void {
722	    if (!this.storage) {
723	      return;
724	    }
725	
726	    const currentEnvelope = this.readEnvelope();
727	    if (entries.length === 0) {
728	      const { [workerId]: _removed, ...workers } = currentEnvelope.workers;
729	      this.envelope = { ...currentEnvelope, workers };
730	      this.scheduleFlush();
731	      return;
732	    }
733	
734	    this.envelope = this.pruneEnvelope({
735	      ...currentEnvelope,
736	      workers: {
737	        ...currentEnvelope.workers,
738	        [workerId]: {
739	          updatedAt: this.now(),
740	          entries,
741	        },
742	      },
743	    });
744	    this.scheduleFlush();
745	  }
746	
747	  /** Write the pending cache envelope to storage now. */
748	  flushCache(): void {
749	    if (this.flushTimer !== null) {
750	      clearTimeout(this.flushTimer);
751	      this.flushTimer = null;
752	    }
753	
754	    const envelope = this.envelope;
755	    if (!this.storage || !envelope) {
756	      return;
757	    }
758	
759	    const serialized = JSON.stringify({
760	      version: 1,
761	      workers: Object.fromEntries(
762	        Object.entries(envelope.workers).map(([id, cached]) => [id, {
763	          updatedAt: cached.updatedAt,
764	          entries: cached.entries.map(compactEntryForCache),
765	        }]),
766	      ),
767	    } satisfies WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope);
768	    if (serialized.length > this.maxSerializedBytes) {
769	      return;
770	    }
771	
772	    try {
773	      this.storage.setItem(this.storageKey, serialized);
774	    } catch {
775	      // localStorage is a preview cache only; live server state remains authoritative.
776	    }
777	  }
778	
779	  private scheduleFlush(): void {
780	    if (this.flushTimer !== null) {
781	      return;
782	    }
783	
784	    if (this.flushIntervalMs <= 0) {
785	      this.flushCache();
786	      return;
787	    }
788	
789	    this.flushTimer = setTimeout(() => {
790	      this.flushTimer = null;
791	      this.flushCache();
792	    }, this.flushIntervalMs);
793	    (this.flushTimer as { unref?: () => void }).unref?.();
794	  }
795	
796	  private readEnvelope(): WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope {
797	    if (!this.storage) {
798	      return emptyEnvelope();
799	    }
800	
801	    if (this.envelope) {
802	      return this.envelope;
803	    }
804	
805	    try {
806	      const raw = this.storage.getItem(this.storageKey);
807	      if (!raw) {
808	        this.envelope = emptyEnvelope();
809	        return this.envelope;
810	      }
811	
812	      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope>;
813	      if (parsed.version !== 1 || typeof parsed.workers !== "object" || parsed.workers === null) {
814	        this.envelope = emptyEnvelope();
815	        return this.envelope;
816	      }
817	      this.envelope = {
818	        version: 1,
819	        workers: parsed.workers as Record<string, CachedWorkerStream>,
820	      };
821	      return this.envelope;
822	    } catch {
823	      try {
824	        this.storage.removeItem(this.storageKey);
825	      } catch {
826	        // Ignore cleanup failures.
827	      }
828	      this.envelope = emptyEnvelope();
829	      return this.envelope;
830	    }
831	  }
832	
833	  private pruneEnvelope(envelope: WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope): WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope {
834	    return {
835	      version: 1,
836	      workers: Object.fromEntries(
837	        Object.entries(envelope.workers)
838	          .sort((left, right) => {
839	            const updatedDelta = right[1].updatedAt - left[1].updatedAt;
840	            return updatedDelta !== 0 ? updatedDelta : left[0].localeCompare(right[0]);
841	          })
842	          .slice(0, this.maxWorkers),
843	      ),
844	    };
845	  }
846	}

848	// A single process-wide instance is fine because manager state is keyed
849	// by workerId and the same worker is never owned by two tabs. The
850	// reset() method exists for tests; production code should not call it.
851	export const workerEntriesManager = new WorkerEntriesManager();
852	
853	/**
854	 * Subscribe to the unified worker conversation stream for a single
855	 * worker. Returns the live state plus a `isLoaded` boolean derived
856	 * from the manager's contiguous-prefix invariant.
857	 *
858	 * `workerId === null` returns a stable empty state and skips the
859	 * fetch.
860	 */
861	interface UseWorkerStreamOptions {
862	  refreshIntervalMs?: number | null;
863	}
864	
865	export function useWorkerStream(
866	  workerId: string | null,
867	  initialEntries: WorkerEntry[] = [],
868	  options: UseWorkerStreamOptions = {},
869	) {
870	  const runtimeApis = useRuntimeAPIs();
871	  workerEntriesManager.configure(runtimeApis.workers.listEntries);
872	  const state = useSyncExternalStore(
873	    useCallback((listener) => (
874	      workerId ? workerEntriesManager.subscribe(workerId, listener) : () => {}
875	    ), [workerId]),
876	    useCallback(() => (
877	      workerId ? workerEntriesManager.getState(workerId, initialEntries) : EMPTY_WORKER_STREAM_STATE
878	    ), [initialEntries, workerId]),
879	    () => EMPTY_WORKER_STREAM_STATE,
880	  );
881	  useEffect(() => {
882	    if (!workerId) {
883	      return;
884	    }
885	    void workerEntriesManager.ensureLoaded(workerId);
886	  }, [workerId]);
887	  useEffect(() => {
888	    if (!workerId || !options.refreshIntervalMs || options.refreshIntervalMs <= 0) {
889	      return;
890	    }
891	    const intervalId = window.setInterval(() => {
892	      void workerEntriesManager.refresh(workerId);
893	    }, options.refreshIntervalMs);
894	    return () => window.clearInterval(intervalId);
895	  }, [options.refreshIntervalMs, workerId]);
896	  const loadOlder = useCallback((limit?: number) => {
897	    if (!workerId) return Promise.resolve();
898	    return workerEntriesManager.loadOlder(workerId, limit);
899	  }, [workerId]);
900	  const entries = useMemo(() => coalesceWorkerEntriesById(state.entries), [state.entries]);
901	  return {
902	    state,
903	    entries,
904	    isLoaded: workerId ? workerEntriesManager.isLoaded(workerId) : false,
905	    hasEverLoaded: workerId ? workerEntriesManager.hasEverLoaded(workerId) : false,
906	    hasOlder: state.hasOlder,
907	    loadOlder,
908	  };
909	}

5	const DIRECT_WORKING_STATUSES = new Set(["starting", "working", "stuck", "recovering"]);
6	const DIRECT_WAITING_RUN_STATUSES = new Set(["quota_waiting", "needs_recovery"]);
7	const TERMINAL_HUMAN_INPUT_STATUSES = new Set([
8	  "answered",
9	  "approved",
10	  "cancelled",
11	  "canceled",
12	  "completed",
13	  "declined",
14	  "denied",
15	  "failed",
16	  "rejected",
17	  "skipped",
18	]);
19	
20	export type DirectControlPendingAssistantStatus = "connecting" | "thinking" | "working";
21	
22	function hasWorkingStatus(statuses: readonly (string | null | undefined)[]) {
23	  return statuses.some((status) => DIRECT_WORKING_STATUSES.has(normalizeWorkerStatus(status)));
24	}
25	
26	function isOpenInputEntry(entry: AgentOutputEntry) {
27	  if (entry.type !== "permission" && entry.type !== "elicitation") {
28	    return false;
29	  }
30	  const status = (entry.status ?? "pending").trim().toLowerCase();
31	  return !TERMINAL_HUMAN_INPUT_STATUSES.has(status);
32	}
33	
34	function entryRequestKey(entry: AgentOutputEntry) {
35	  const raw = entry.raw;
36	  if (typeof raw !== "object" || raw === null) {
37	    return null;
38	  }
39	  const requestId = (raw as { requestId?: unknown }).requestId;
40	  return typeof requestId === "number" && Number.isFinite(requestId)
41	    ? `${entry.type}:${requestId}`
42	    : null;
43	}
44	
45	export function countOpenHumanInputEntries(
46	  entries: readonly AgentOutputEntry[] | null | undefined,
47	  inputType?: "permission" | "elicitation",
48	) {
49	  const openByRequestKey = new Map<string, boolean>();
50	  let unkeyedOpenCount = 0;
51	
52	  for (const entry of entries ?? []) {
53	    if (entry.type !== "permission" && entry.type !== "elicitation") {
54	      continue;
55	    }
56	    if (inputType && entry.type !== inputType) {
57	      continue;
58	    }
59	
60	    const open = isOpenInputEntry(entry);
61	    const requestKey = entryRequestKey(entry);
62	    if (!requestKey) {
63	      if (open) {
64	        unkeyedOpenCount += 1;
65	      }
66	      continue;
67	    }
68	
69	    openByRequestKey.set(requestKey, open);
70	  }
71	
72	  return unkeyedOpenCount + [...openByRequestKey.values()].filter(Boolean).length;
73	}
74	
75	export function hasPendingHumanInputSignal(agent: {
76	  pendingPermissions?: unknown[] | null;
77	  pendingElicitations?: unknown[] | null;
78	  outputEntries?: AgentOutputEntry[] | null;
79	}) {
80	  return (
81	    (agent.pendingPermissions?.length ?? 0) > 0
82	    || (agent.pendingElicitations?.length ?? 0) > 0
83	    || countOpenHumanInputEntries(agent.outputEntries) > 0
84	  );
85	}

87	export function resolveDirectControlPendingAssistantStatus(args: {
88	  isDirectConversation: boolean;
89	  pendingConversationWorkerId: string | null | undefined;
90	  busyConversationWorkerId: string | null | undefined;
91	  selectedRunStatus: string | null | undefined;
92	  workerStatuses: readonly (string | null | undefined)[];
93	  agentStates: readonly (string | null | undefined)[];
94	  hasAgentCurrentText: boolean;
95	  hasPendingHumanInput?: boolean;
96	}) {
97	  if (!args.isDirectConversation) {
98	    return null;
99	  }
100	
101	  if (isTerminalRunStatus(args.selectedRunStatus)) {
102	    return null;
103	  }
104	
105	  if (DIRECT_WAITING_RUN_STATUSES.has((args.selectedRunStatus ?? "").trim().toLowerCase())) {
106	    return null;
107	  }
108	
109	  if (args.hasPendingHumanInput) {
110	    return null;
111	  }
112	
113	  if (args.busyConversationWorkerId || hasWorkingStatus(args.workerStatuses) || hasWorkingStatus(args.agentStates)) {
114	    return "working";
115	  }
116	
117	  if (args.hasAgentCurrentText) {
118	    return "thinking";
119	  }
120	
121	  if (args.pendingConversationWorkerId) {
122	    return "connecting";
123	  }
124	
125	  return null;
126	}
127	
128	export function shouldShowDirectControlPendingAssistant(args: Parameters<typeof resolveDirectControlPendingAssistantStatus>[0]) {
129	  return resolveDirectControlPendingAssistantStatus(args) !== null;
130	}
131	
132	/**
133	 * Final say on the "Working…" row, applied where the prompt cards actually
134	 * render. `resolveDirectControlPendingAssistantStatus` suppresses the row via
135	 * `hasPendingHumanInput`, but it only sees the live agent snapshot, whereas the
136	 * elicitation card renders from a union of that snapshot and prompts derived
137	 * from the durable worker-entry stream. Any frame that lost the live pending
138	 * request — a degraded/persisted SSE frame, or a runtime fetch that raced the
139	 * poll — left the card on screen (worker entries still carry it) while the
140	 * indicator flipped back on, so "Working…" blinked in and out on every frame
141	 * and shoved the whole form down the page mid-answer.
142	 *
143	 * A rendered prompt means the turn is parked on the user, and the indicator is
144	 * a placeholder for assistant output that has not arrived yet, so the two can
145	 * never legitimately be true at once. Deciding that from the same counts that
146	 * gate the cards keeps them consistent no matter which source flickers.
147	 */
148	export function shouldShowDirectControlWorkingIndicator(args: {
149	  pendingAssistantVisible: boolean;
150	  primaryConversationWorkerId: string | null | undefined;
151	  renderedElicitationCount: number;
152	  renderedPermissionCount: number;
153	}) {
154	  if (!args.pendingAssistantVisible) {
155	    return false;
156	  }
157	
158	  const hasRenderedPrompt = Boolean(args.primaryConversationWorkerId)
159	    && (args.renderedElicitationCount > 0 || args.renderedPermissionCount > 0);
160	
161	  return !hasRenderedPrompt;
162	}
163	
164	export function isMutationPendingForSelectedRun(args: {
165	  isPending: boolean;
166	  mutationRunId: string | null | undefined;
167	  selectedRunId: string | null | undefined;
168	}) {
169	  return Boolean(
170	    args.isPending
171	      && args.selectedRunId
172	      && args.mutationRunId === args.selectedRunId,
173	  );
174	}
175	
176	export function resolvePendingConversationWorkerId(args: {
177	  isPending: boolean;
178	  mutationRunId: string | null | undefined;
179	  selectedRunId: string | null | undefined;
180	  isImplementationConversation: boolean;
181	  selectedWorkerIds: readonly string[];
182	}) {
183	  if (args.isImplementationConversation) {
184	    return null;
185	  }
186	
187	  if (!isMutationPendingForSelectedRun({
188	    isPending: args.isPending,
189	    mutationRunId: args.mutationRunId,
190	    selectedRunId: args.selectedRunId,
191	  })) {
192	    return null;
193	  }
194	
195	  return args.selectedWorkerIds[0] ?? null;
196	}

import type { WorkerStreamState } from "./WorkerEntriesManager";
import { coalesceWorkerEntriesById } from "./WorkerEntriesManager";
import type { WorkerEntry } from "@/shared/worker-entries";
import { withoutSupersededEntries, type SupersededSeqRange } from "@/lib/superseded-entries";

export type ConversationLoadState = {
  snapshotLoaded: boolean;
  workerStreamRequired: boolean;
  workerStreamLoaded: boolean;
  fullyLoaded: boolean;
  loadingReason: "snapshot" | "worker_stream" | null;
};

export function isWorkerStreamCaughtUp(streamState: WorkerStreamState) {
  return (
    streamState.status === "loaded"
    && streamState.latestContiguousSeq === streamState.latestKnownSeq
  );
}

export function deriveConversationLoadState(args: {
  snapshotLoaded: boolean;
  unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled: boolean;
  primaryConversationWorkerId: string | null | undefined;
  streamState: WorkerStreamState;
  selectedRunIsTerminal?: boolean;
}): ConversationLoadState {
  const workerStreamRequired = Boolean(
    args.unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled
      && args.primaryConversationWorkerId
      && !args.selectedRunIsTerminal
  );
  const workerStreamLoaded = !workerStreamRequired || isWorkerStreamCaughtUp(args.streamState);
  const fullyLoaded = args.snapshotLoaded && workerStreamLoaded;
  const loadingReason = !args.snapshotLoaded
    ? "snapshot"
    : !workerStreamLoaded
      ? "worker_stream"
      : null;

  return {
    snapshotLoaded: args.snapshotLoaded,
    workerStreamRequired,
    workerStreamLoaded,
    fullyLoaded,
    loadingReason,
  };
}

export function shouldShowDirectWorkerStreamInitialLoading(args: {
  unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled: boolean;
  primaryConversationWorkerId: string | null | undefined;
  streamState: WorkerStreamState;
}) {
  return deriveConversationLoadState({
    ...args,
    snapshotLoaded: true,
  }).loadingReason === "worker_stream"
    && (args.streamState.status === "idle" || args.streamState.status === "loading")
    && args.streamState.entries.length === 0;
}

export function shouldShowDirectConversationLoading(args: ConversationLoadState) {
  return Boolean(
    !args.fullyLoaded
    && args.loadingReason === "worker_stream"
  );
}

export function selectDirectConversationEntries<T extends WorkerEntry>(args: {
  transcriptEntries: T[];
  directWorkerEntries: T[];
  // Ranges the live worker wrote for a branch a retry/edit discarded. The
  // transcript already drops them server-side; the live stream is served from
  // the raw JSONL (no database read on that hot path), so they are filtered
  // here before the two sources are merged — otherwise the rewound turn walks
  // straight back into the conversation.
  supersededSeqRanges?: SupersededSeqRange[];
  // The run's workers in creation order, so a message that exists on more than
  // one of them is placed where the newest worker has it.
  workerOrder?: ReadonlyArray<string>;
}) {
  const directWorkerEntries = withoutSupersededEntries(
    args.directWorkerEntries,
    args.supersededSeqRanges ?? [],
  );

  if (args.transcriptEntries.length === 0) {
    return directWorkerEntries;
  }

  return coalesceWorkerEntriesById([
    ...args.transcriptEntries,
    ...directWorkerEntries,
  ], args.workerOrder ?? []) as T[];
}

export function resolveDirectWorkerStreamRefreshInterval(args: {
  unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled: boolean;
  primaryConversationWorkerId: string | null | undefined;
  activeRefreshIntervalMs: number;
  validationIntervalMs: number;
  showDirectControlWorkingIndicator: boolean;
  selectedRunIsTerminal?: boolean;
}) {
  if (!args.unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled || !args.primaryConversationWorkerId) {
    return null;
  }

  return args.showDirectControlWorkingIndicator
    ? args.activeRefreshIntervalMs
    : args.validationIntervalMs;
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useRef, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import type { StateManager } from "@/lib/state-manager";

export function useManagerSnapshot<TState>(manager: StateManager<TState>) {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    useCallback((listener) => manager.subscribe(listener), [manager]),
    useCallback(() => manager.getSnapshot(), [manager]),
    useCallback(() => manager.getInitialSnapshot(), [manager]),
  );
}

export function shallowEqualRecord<TRecord extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  left: TRecord,
  right: TRecord,
) {
  if (Object.is(left, right)) {
    return true;
  }

  const leftKeys = Object.keys(left);
  const rightKeys = Object.keys(right);
  if (leftKeys.length !== rightKeys.length) {
    return false;
  }

  return leftKeys.every((key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(right, key)
    && Object.is(left[key], right[key]));
}

export function useManagerSelector<TState, TSelected>(
  manager: StateManager<TState>,
  selector: (state: TState) => TSelected,
  isEqual: (left: TSelected, right: TSelected) => boolean = Object.is,
) {
  const selectionRef = useRef<{
    state: TState;
    selection: TSelected;
  } | null>(null);
  const serverSelectionRef = useRef<{
    state: TState;
    selector: (state: TState) => TSelected;
    selection: TSelected;
  } | null>(null);

  const getSelectedSnapshot = useCallback(() => {
    const state = manager.getSnapshot();
    const previous = selectionRef.current;
    if (previous?.state === state) {
      return previous.selection;
    }

    const nextSelection = selector(state);
    if (previous && isEqual(previous.selection, nextSelection)) {
      selectionRef.current = {
        state,
        selection: previous.selection,
      };
      return previous.selection;
    }

    selectionRef.current = {
      state,
      selection: nextSelection,
    };
    return nextSelection;
  }, [isEqual, manager, selector]);
  const getServerSelectedSnapshot = useCallback(() => {
    const state = manager.getInitialSnapshot();
    const previous = serverSelectionRef.current;
    if (previous?.state === state && previous.selector === selector) {
      return previous.selection;
    }
    const selection = selector(state);
    serverSelectionRef.current = { state, selector, selection };
    return selection;
  }, [manager, selector]);

  return useSyncExternalStore(
    useCallback((listener) => manager.subscribe(listener), [manager]),
    getSelectedSnapshot,
    getServerSelectedSnapshot,
  );
}

      if (isAlreadyResolvedHumanInputError(error)) {

3	export function calculateEventPayloadChecksum(payload: Record<string, unknown>): string {
4	  const { snapshotChecksum: _snapshotChecksum, ...checksumPayload } = payload;
5	  return `sha256:${createHash("sha256")
6	    .update(JSON.stringify(checksumPayload))
7	    .digest("base64url")}`;
8	}
9

11	  return {
12	    ...payload,
13	    snapshotChecksum: calculateEventPayloadChecksum(payload),
14	  };

## Claude · 2026-08-05T10:30:50.257Z

I've launched four parallel investigations and done initial reconnaissance. Two things already stand out from the repo itself:

**No virtualization library is installed at all** — `package.json` has no `react-window`/`react-virtual`/`virtuoso`. If the transcript renders every entry, a long multi-session conversation is putting the entire history in the DOM.

**`Terminal.tsx` is 2693 lines and subscribes broadly.** Five separate `useManagerSnapshot(terminalUiManager)` calls (`Terminal.tsx:1296,1479,1559,1752` and `conversationCopyNoticeManager` at 1912) read the *whole* manager state. `useManagerSnapshot` notifies on any change, so toggling one tool group plausibly re-renders every entry in the transcript. That directly contradicts the project's own rule in `docs/architecture/frontend-state-and-rendering.md:49` ("high-churn state lives behind a narrow `useManagerSelector`") and its explicit ban on components above a worker card subscribing to per-worker scroll state.

Worth knowing: there's substantial prior art here. `docs/architecture/hot-path-responsiveness-and-resource-leaks.md` documents two rounds of this class of failure (May 20 and May 22, 2026), both fixed **server-side** — unbounded caches, full-file transcript reads, snapshot payloads carrying transcript bodies. Your symptoms this time are client-side interactivity (click latency, scroll jank), which that work didn't address. `HomeApp.tsx` is also 1678 lines against a documented target of 700, which suggests the subscription boundaries have drifted.

The four agents are auditing, in parallel:
1. **SSE ingest → re-render fanout** — whether one frame triggers a full snapshot refetch and a whole-tree re-render
2. **Server snapshot cost** — payload size and unbounded arrays with N runs in flight
3. **Transcript rendering** — virtualization, memoization, highlight.js on every render, auto-scroll layout thrashing
4. **Sidebar + cross-run recomputation + the question forms** — what runs over all runs/workers per frame, and what happens on click

I'll report the consolidated diagnosis with file:line evidence when they land, then fix in priority order.

2	export type StateListener = () => void;

4	export class StateManager<TState> {
5	  private state: TState;
6	  private readonly initialState: TState;
7	  private readonly listeners = new Set<StateListener>();
8	
9	  constructor(initialState: TState) {
10	    this.state = initialState;
11	    this.initialState = initialState;
12	  }
13	
14	  getSnapshot() {
15	    return this.state;
16	  }
17	
18	  getInitialSnapshot() {
19	    return this.initialState;
20	  }
21	
22	  subscribe(listener: StateListener) {
23	    this.listeners.add(listener);
24	    return () => {
25	      this.listeners.delete(listener);
26	    };
27	  }
28	
29	  update(updater: StateUpdate<TState>, notify = true) {
30	    const nextState = typeof updater === "function"
31	      ? (updater as (current: TState) => TState)(this.state)
32	      : updater;
33

35	      return this.state;
36	    }
37

39	    if (notify) {

41	    }
42	    return this.state;
43	  }
44

46	    return this.update((current) => ({
47	      ...current,
48	      ...(typeof patch === "function" ? patch(current) : patch),
49	    }), notify);

51	
52	  setKey<TKey extends keyof TState>(key: TKey, value: StateUpdate<TState[TKey]>, notify = true) {

54	      const nextValue = typeof value === "function"
55	        ? (value as (currentValue: TState[TKey]) => TState[TKey])(current[key])

1	"use client";

3	import { useCallback, useRef, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
4	import type { StateManager } from "@/lib/state-manager";
5	
6	export function useManagerSnapshot<TState>(manager: StateManager<TState>) {
7	  return useSyncExternalStore(
8	    useCallback((listener) => manager.subscribe(listener), [manager]),
9	    useCallback(() => manager.getSnapshot(), [manager]),
10	    useCallback(() => manager.getInitialSnapshot(), [manager]),
11	  );
12	}
13	
14	export function shallowEqualRecord<TRecord extends Record<string, unknown>>(
15	  left: TRecord,
16	  right: TRecord,
17	) {
18	  if (Object.is(left, right)) {
19	    return true;
20	  }
21	
22	  const leftKeys = Object.keys(left);
23	  const rightKeys = Object.keys(right);
24	  if (leftKeys.length !== rightKeys.length) {
25	    return false;
26	  }
27	
28	  return leftKeys.every((key) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(right, key)
29	    && Object.is(left[key], right[key]));
30	}
31	
32	export function useManagerSelector<TState, TSelected>(
33	  manager: StateManager<TState>,
34	  selector: (state: TState) => TSelected,
35	  isEqual: (left: TSelected, right: TSelected) => boolean = Object.is,
36	) {
37	  const selectionRef = useRef<{
38	    state: TState;
39	    selection: TSelected;
40	  } | null>(null);
41	  const serverSelectionRef = useRef<{
42	    state: TState;
43	    selector: (state: TState) => TSelected;
44	    selection: TSelected;
45	  } | null>(null);
46	
47	  const getSelectedSnapshot = useCallback(() => {
48	    const state = manager.getSnapshot();
49	    const previous = selectionRef.current;
50	    if (previous?.state === state) {
51	      return previous.selection;
52	    }
53	
54	    const nextSelection = selector(state);
55	    if (previous && isEqual(previous.selection, nextSelection)) {
56	      selectionRef.current = {
57	        state,
58	        selection: previous.selection,
59	      };
60	      return previous.selection;
61	    }
62	
63	    selectionRef.current = {
64	      state,
65	      selection: nextSelection,
66	    };
67	    return nextSelection;
68	  }, [isEqual, manager, selector]);
69	  const getServerSelectedSnapshot = useCallback(() => {
70	    const state = manager.getInitialSnapshot();
71	    const previous = serverSelectionRef.current;
72	    if (previous?.state === state && previous.selector === selector) {
73	      return previous.selection;
74	    }
75	    const selection = selector(state);
76	    serverSelectionRef.current = { state, selector, selection };
77	    return selection;
78	  }, [manager, selector]);
79	
80	  return useSyncExternalStore(
81	    useCallback((listener) => manager.subscribe(listener), [manager]),
82	    getSelectedSnapshot,
83	    getServerSelectedSnapshot,
84	  );
85	}
86

import { createHash } from "node:crypto";

export function calculateEventPayloadChecksum(payload: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const { snapshotChecksum: _snapshotChecksum, ...checksumPayload } = payload;
  return `sha256:${createHash("sha256")
    .update(JSON.stringify(checksumPayload))
    .digest("base64url")}`;
}

export function withEventPayloadChecksum<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(payload: T): T & { snapshotChecksum: string } {
  return {
    ...payload,
    snapshotChecksum: calculateEventPayloadChecksum(payload),
  };
}

function ActivityPane({
  label,
  text,
  variant,
  projectRoot,
  onOpenProjectFile,
  preview = false,
  expanded = true,
  interactive = true,
  onClick,
}: {
  label: string;
  text: string;
  variant: "terminal" | "native";
  projectRoot?: string | null;
  onOpenProjectFile?: (file: ProjectFileReference) => void;
  preview?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  interactive?: boolean;
  onClick?: () => void;
}) {
  const lines = text.split("\n");
  const canExpand = preview && lines.length > TOOL_OUTPUT_PREVIEW_LINES;
  const canInteract = canExpand && interactive;
  const clipped = canExpand && !expanded;
  const previewStyle: CSSProperties | undefined = canExpand
    ? { maxHeight: clipped ? TOOL_OUTPUT_COLLAPSED_MAX_HEIGHT : TOOL_OUTPUT_EXPANDED_MAX_HEIGHT }
    : undefined;

  return (
    <div
      style={previewStyle}
      className={cn(
        "overflow-hidden",
        canInteract && "cursor-pointer",
        canExpand && "transition-[max-height,background-color,border-color,box-shadow] duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none",
        variant === "native"
          ? "rounded border border-border/60 bg-muted/25"
          : "rounded border border-border/70 bg-background shadow-sm dark:border-white/10 dark:bg-[#111318] dark:shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.02)]",
      )}
      onClick={canInteract ? onClick : undefined}
      role={canInteract ? "button" : undefined}
      tabIndex={canInteract ? 0 : undefined}
      title={canInteract ? (expanded ? "Click to collapse output preview" : "Click to expand full output") : undefined}
      onKeyDown={canInteract ? (event) => {
        if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
          event.preventDefault();
          onClick?.();
        }
      } : undefined}
    >
      <div className="flex items-stretch">
        <div className={cn(
          "flex w-8 shrink-0 items-start justify-center border-r px-1 py-2 font-mono text-[length:var(--terminal-pane-label-size)] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em]",
          variant === "native"
            ? "border-border/60 bg-background/40 text-muted-foreground"
            : "border-border/60 bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground dark:border-white/8 dark:bg-black/20 dark:text-zinc-500",
        )}>
          {label}
        </div>
        <pre className={cn(
          "min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-auto px-2.5 py-2 font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap break-words",
          "text-[length:var(--terminal-pane-size)]",
          variant === "native" ? "leading-[1.5]" : "leading-[1.55]",
          clipped && "line-clamp-[3]",
          variant === "native" ? "text-foreground" : "text-foreground dark:text-zinc-200",
        )}>
          <ProjectFileReferenceText
            text={text}
            projectRoot={projectRoot}
            onOpenProjectFile={onOpenProjectFile}
          />
        </pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type DiffDisplayRow = {
  id: string;
  kind: "context" | "add" | "remove" | "separator";
  visible: string;
  lineNumber: number | null;
};

type ParsedDiffPane = {
  fileName: string | null;
  added: number;
  removed: number;
  rows: DiffDisplayRow[];
};

function basenameDiffPath(value: string): string {
  const trimmed = value.trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
  const cleaned = trimmed.replace(/^(?:a|b)\//, "");
  const segments = cleaned.split(/[/\\]/).filter(Boolean);
  return segments[segments.length - 1] || cleaned || trimmed;

function DiffPane({
  text,
  variant,
  preview = false,
  expanded = true,
  interactive = true,

}: {
  text: string;
  variant: "terminal" | "native";

  expanded?: boolean;
  interactive?: boolean;

  const canInteract = canExpand && interactive;

    ? { maxHeight: clipped ? TOOL_OUTPUT_COLLAPSED_MAX_HEIGHT : TOOL_OUTPUT_EXPANDED_MAX_HEIGHT }
    : undefined;

function ProjectFileReferenceText({
  text,
  projectRoot,
  onOpenProjectFile,
}: {
  text: string;
  projectRoot?: string | null;
  onOpenProjectFile?: (file: ProjectFileReference) => void;
}) {
  if (!projectRoot || !onOpenProjectFile) {
    return text;
  }

  const nodes: ReactNode[] = [];
  let lastIndex = 0;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  PROJECT_FILE_REFERENCE_TOKEN_PATTERN.lastIndex = 0;
  while ((match = PROJECT_FILE_REFERENCE_TOKEN_PATTERN.exec(text))) {
    const token = [REDACTED]
    const reference = parseProjectFileReference(token, projectRoot);
    if (!reference) {
      continue;
    }

    if (match.index > lastIndex) {
      nodes.push(text.slice(lastIndex, match.index));
    }

    nodes.push(
      <ProjectFileContextMenu
        key={`${match.index}:${token}`}
        reference={reference}
        onOpen={onOpenProjectFile}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          className="inline font-mono text-inherit underline decoration-current/35 underline-offset-4 hover:decoration-current"
          onClick={(event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            onOpenProjectFile(reference);
          }}
        >
          {token}
        </button>
      </ProjectFileContextMenu>,
    );
    lastIndex = match.index + token.length;
  }

  if (nodes.length === 0) {
    return text;
  }

  if (lastIndex < text.length) {
    nodes.push(text.slice(lastIndex));
  }

  return nodes;
}
